jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Are you excited by the idea of using geospatial data to help restore habitats, protect wildlife, and tackle climate change?
jobs.description:
Are you excited by the idea of using geospatial data to help restore habitats, protect wildlife, and tackle climate change? So are we. At Oxygen Conservation, geospatial data isn’t background infrastructure – it shapes everything we do, one acquisition, one Biodiversity Net Gain project and one data collection app at a time. As we scale, we’re creating a new Geospatial Analyst role to power the mapping and data work behind our Natural Capital projects, our acquisitions pipeline, and our own internal software products. You’ll learn directly from Lara Salam, our GIS and Data Visualisation Lead, who’s built our entire GIS function from scratch, and grow your career at the pace we’re growing ours.

About You

We're looking for someone who’s eager to learn, grow, and take their technical skills and career to the next level – with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity about data, and an appetite for using AI to work smarter. Ideally, you’ll bring the following:

Environment

  • Passionate Explorer: Fuelled by a genuine passion for environmental conservation and making a tangible impact on the landscapes we protect.

  • Spatial Data Practitioner: Hands-on experience analysing, visualising, and managing spatial datasets, ideally within the ArcGIS Platform.

Impact

  • Data-Driven: Sharp attention to detail and a high standard for data quality in everything you touch.

  • Clear Communicator: Able to turn complex data into clear insights and visualisations, whether it’s a beautiful map, an informative dashboard, or a well-structured dataset.

Adventure

  • AI-Enabled Experimenter: Genuinely interested in using AI tools (think Claude Code) to write Python, automate workflows, and speed up your own work. No computer science background required, just curiosity and a willingness to have a go.

  • Practical Problem Solver: When the obvious approach doesn’t work, you try another, and another. You think outside the box rather than getting stuck.

Together

  • Commitment to Growth: A passion for lifelong learning and continuous personal development, growing alongside a team that invests in you.

  • Kindness and Approachability: And of course, you have to be really kind! Sharing snacks on long journeys or a packed lunch whilst out in the rain is mandatory!

We’re imagining this role for someone early in their GIS career, whether you’re finishing education, changing direction, or taking another route into the field. With direct coaching from Lara, we’ll support your growth and development. We believe in recruiting exceptional people and building a genuinely diverse team from across the country, with a broad range of lived and learned experiences. So, if you have some or all of the skills above, are full of enthusiasm, passionate about learning, and ready to work hard to Scale Conservation, apply now!

About the Role

As our Geospatial Analyst, you’ll be the engine room behind our Natural Capital projects and our growing suite of internal GIS tools. As Lara leads our geospatial strategy and internal software products, you’ll deliver hands-on GIS work that keeps our projects moving forward, with her coaching and mentoring you every step of the way. Once in the role, you’ll be joining a small, high-performing team that genuinely cares about you and your growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Natural Capital Mapping: Build and maintain the mapping and data behind our Biodiversity Net Gain, biodiversity credit and other Natural Capital projects, from baseline surveys through to vision maps, ready for planning and delivery.

  • New Frontiers: Get stuck into new areas of Natural Capital as we expand (think soil carbon and beyond), finding and building the datasets and maps that these emerging project types need.

  • Acquisitions Support: Source, prepare and quality-check the spatial data behind our acquisitions, from estate-level detail to country and regional-level searches, and help us automate more of this workflow through our internal tools.

  • Tools, Automation & Data Curation: Support the maintenance of our ArcGIS web and mobile apps, StoryMaps and dashboards, help streamline the manual and repetitive parts of our GIS workflows, and turn messy external data into clean, styled, ready-to-use datasets.

About us

Oxygen Conservation was founded in 2021 with a clear mission: Scaling Conservation. We're building the UK's first genuine natural capital portfolio, acquiring large landscapes, restoring them at scale, and creating investable natural capital products including premium carbon credits, biodiversity net gain units, renewable energy partnerships, and ecotourism experiences.

In just four years, we've grown to a valuation of around £400m, with 50,000+ acres owned and over half a million acres connected for nature. By 2030, we aim to have £1 billion of natural capital assets under management, enabling us to protect and restore 250,000 acres of land for people and wildlife.

Oxygen Capital is the investment and finance division of Oxygen Conservation, focused on raising capital, developing natural capital opportunities, and supporting the commercial growth of large-scale conservation. Oxygen Intelligence is our data and analytical infrastructure division, providing the insight, measurement, and proprietary tools that underpin our wider platform. While each division has a distinct external focus, all teams sit within the wider Oxygen Conservation platform and work closely together to deliver our mission of scaling conservation.

We move fast, hold ourselves to high standards, and genuinely believe that what we're building matters. If that sounds like the kind of place you do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Information

Term: Full-time, permanent.

Location: Remote (some travel to estates or other meetings expected).

Salary: £28,000

Closing date: 21st August

How to Apply: Visit our website and share your GIS work or a portfolio you’re proud of to support your application.

We're looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead multiple engineering teams within our Onboarding and Timekeeping product line — one of the most active and strategically important areas of the business. This is a role for a leader, not just a manager. You'll cultivate ownership and decision-making at the team level, develop strong engineering anchors, and create an environment where your teams don't wait for direction — they are empowered to move.

You'll own the engineering execution of a robust product roadmap that includes mobile applications in a rapid growth phase, drive deep collaboration with Product and QA, and connect your teams into the broader engineering organization through a Spotify-inspired model of Squads, Tribes, Chapters, and Guilds. You'll also champion our initiative to embed AI meaningfully into how we build software.

We're in the middle of a cultural shift — moving faster, owning outcomes, celebrating wins, and holding each other to a high bar. We work hard and play hard. This role requires someone who can get up to speed quickly, lead with empathy from day one, and immediately begin delivering impact.

Servant Leadership & Team Development

  • Champion a work hard, play hard team culture — high standards, fast feedback, and genuine celebration of wins

Spotify Model: Squads, Tribes, Chapters & Guilds

Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Senior Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

  • Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
  • Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
  • Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

  • Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
  • Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
  • Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.
  • A hunter’s instinct for new logos combined with the relationship acumen to grow and retain existing accounts.
  • Polished enterprise presence with the ability to engage confidently at VP and C-suite level across business and technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling within one or more of Pythian’s core technology ecosystems: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini) and/or Oracle (database, infrastructure), and also AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or SAP.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack and cloud data platforms across multiple hyperscalers.
  • Comfort positioning AI solutions — Agentic AI, GenAI/RAG, MLOps, AI automation — to enterprise decision-makers.
  • Experience with Database Managed Services or Infrastructure Managed Services sales cycles and pricing models.
  • Background selling into $300M–$1B revenue companies in manufacturing, retail, logistics, finance, or healthcare verticals.
  • Relevant cloud, database, or AI certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic territory planning and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consultative selling — ability to diagnose business problems before proposing solutions.
  • Influence, persuasion, and consensus-building across complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Continuous learning mindset — genuinely curious about AI developments and their enterprise implications.
  • Clear, compelling written and verbal communication; strong presentation and proposal skills.
  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of experience and education.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

AI Disclaimer

While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by, and remain the responsibility of, human decision-makers. 26WD100492, Principal Data Analyst

Position Overview

Autodesk has invested in data-driven decision-making, optimizing our platform’s business, product, and cost. The next five years will transform how we work, with a surge in data volume and scaling of AI/ML to provide even greater value to our customers. We are looking for a Principal Data Analyst to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted thought partner to Product, Engineering, Strategy, Research, and business leaders. You will define how success is measured, uncover high-value opportunities, lead rigorous experimentation, and build trusted analytical products and AI assisted workflows that turn complex data into better decisions at scale.

This role combines deep product analytics judgment, strong SQL/Python capability, software engineering discipline, and practical fluency with modern AI tools. You will operate comfortably in ambiguity, influence product direction, and create reusable systems that increase the leverage of teams across the organization.

If you are excited about empowering teams and influencing the organization with insights that drive success, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to identify, define, and address business problems and opportunities through data analysis

  • Use your analytical skills to derive actionable insights from large and complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Define product measurement across north-star metrics, KPI/OKR frameworks, metric trees, instrumentation, guardrails, and launch measurement for platform initiatives

  • Use AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate SQL/Python development, automate repeatable analytical work, prototype lightweight data applications or assistants, and create reusable workflows with appropriate validation, provenance, and human review

  • Create clear and impactful data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar, to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization

  • Build and evolve canonical datasets, semantic models, metric definitions, dashboards, and self-service experiences that can be reliably consumed by both people and AI systems

  • Proactively mine for data drive insights to support PSET's platform outcomes, focusing on performance, user engagement, and overall business impact

  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality, lineage, observability, and scalable pipelines; use version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development practices for high-value analytical assets

  • Communicate complex findings as concise decisions and trade-offs for technical and executive audiences; mentor analysts and cross-functional partners on problem framing, experimentation, AI-assisted analytics, and data storytelling

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in large data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated principal/staff level scope: independently shaping ambiguous problems, influencing product roadmaps, and driving decisions across multiple teams

  • Hands on experience using AI assisted development and analysis tools (Claude Code, Cursor etc.) to accelerate coding, automate workflows, prototype tools, or extend beyond traditional analyst workflows

  • Strong skills in data querying and manipulation with SQL, and proficiency in programming languages like Python or R for data analysis and modeling. Experience with data warehouse ELT tools (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)

  • Experience with semantic layers, governed metric definitions, and BI/visualization tools such as Looker or Power BI, with a track record of enabling trustworthy self-service analytics

  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to work independently on complex datasets and derive actionable insights

  • Knowledge of statistical techniques and modeling methodologies to drive in-depth data insights and support predictive analytics

  • Strong ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner

  • Effective team player with a strong ability to work across functions, engage with diverse stakeholders, and provide data-driven support for strategic initiatives

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working in a SaaS company or a platform engineering organization is preferred

  • Familiarity with Autodesk’s product portfolio and its applications in various industries is an advantage

  • Experience analyzing AI/ML or agentic products, including evaluation frameworks and quality, task success, latency, reliability, or cost trade-offs

  • Experience building lightweight internal data products, analytical applications, or LLM enabled tools connected to governed enterprise data

  • Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline

26WD100492, Analyste principal des données

Aperçu du Poste

Autodesk s’est engagé dans une démarche de prise de décision fondée sur les données, visant à optimiser les activités, les produits et les coûts de notre plateforme. Les cinq prochaines années vont transformer notre façon de travailler, avec une explosion du volume de données et une généralisation de l’IA et du ML afin d’apporter encore plus de valeur à nos clients. Nous recherchons un analyste de données principal qui jouera le rôle de collaborateur senior et de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des responsables des produits, de l’ingénierie, de la stratégie, de la recherche et des dirigeants de l’entreprise. Vous définirez les indicateurs de réussite, identifierez les opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée, mènerez des expérimentations rigoureuses et développerez des outils analytiques fiables ainsi que des flux de travail assistés par l’IA, capables de transformer des données complexes en meilleures décisions à grande échelle.

Ce poste allie un sens aigu de l’analyse produit, de solides compétences en SQL et Python, une rigueur en ingénierie logicielle et une maîtrise pratique des outils modernes d’IA. Vous serez à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, influencerez l’orientation des produits et créerez des systèmes réutilisables qui renforceront l’efficacité des équipes à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.

Si vous êtes motivé(e) par l’idée de donner les moyens d’agir aux équipes et d’influencer l’organisation grâce à des informations qui favorisent la réussite, ce poste est fait pour vous !

Responsabilités

  • Collaborer avec les chefs de produit et les équipes transversales pour identifier, définir et traiter les problèmes et opportunités métier par le biais de l’analyse de données

  • Utiliser vos compétences analytiques pour tirer des enseignements exploitables à partir d’ensembles de données volumineux et complexes, et communiquer vos conclusions de manière claire et concise à un public technique et non technique

  • Définir les mesures de performance des produits à travers les indicateurs phares, les cadres KPI/OKR, les arborescences de métriques, l’instrumentation, les garde-fous et les mesures de lancement pour les initiatives de la plateforme

  • Utiliser des outils de codage et d’analyse basés sur l’IA pour accélérer le développement en SQL/Python, automatiser les tâches analytiques récurrentes, prototyper des applications ou des assistants de données légers, et créer des flux de travail réutilisables avec validation, traçabilité et révision humaine appropriées

  • Créer des visualisations de données claires et percutantes à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI, Looker ou similaires, afin de communiquer les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes de toute l’organisation

  • Construire et faire évoluer des ensembles de données canoniques, des modèles sémantiques, des définitions de métriques, des tableaux de bord et des expériences en libre-service pouvant être exploités de manière fiable tant par les utilisateurs que par les systèmes d’IA

  • Exploiter de manière proactive les données pour en tirer des enseignements permettant de soutenir les résultats de la plateforme PSET, en mettant l’accent sur la performance, l’engagement des utilisateurs et l’impact global sur l’activité

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données sur la qualité des données, la traçabilité, l’observabilité et les pipelines évolutifs ; utiliser le contrôle de version, les tests, la revue de code et des pratiques de développement reproductibles pour les actifs analytiques à forte valeur ajoutée

  • Communiquer des conclusions complexes sous forme de décisions concises et de compromis à l’intention d’un public technique et de direction ; encadrer les analystes et les partenaires interfonctionnels sur la formulation des problèmes, l’expérimentation, l’analyse assistée par l’IA et la mise en valeur des données

Qualifications Minimales

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans l’analyse de grandes quantités de données, la business intelligence ou un domaine connexe, de préférence dans un environnement technologique ou SaaS

  • Licence dans un domaine quantitatif tel que la science des données, les statistiques, les mathématiques ou une discipline connexe. Capacité avérée à agir au niveau d’un responsable ou d’un cadre : cerner de manière autonome des problèmes ambigus, influencer les feuilles de route des produits et piloter les décisions au sein de plusieurs équipes

  • Expérience pratique de l’utilisation d’outils de développement et d’analyse assistés par l’IA (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) pour accélérer le codage, automatiser les flux de travail, prototyper des outils ou aller au-delà des flux de travail traditionnels des analystes

  • Solides compétences en interrogation et manipulation de données avec SQL, et maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python ou R pour l’analyse et la modélisation des données. Expérience avec les outils ELT de data warehouse (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)

  • Expérience avec les couches sémantiques, les définitions de métriques gouvernées et les outils de BI/visualisation tels que Looker ou Power BI, avec une expérience avérée dans la mise en place d’analyses en libre-service fiables

  • Capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes avérées, avec la capacité de travailler de manière autonome sur des ensembles de données complexes et d’en tirer des enseignements exploitables

  • Connaissance des techniques statistiques et des méthodologies de modélisation pour obtenir des analyses approfondies des données et soutenir l’analyse prédictive

  • Grande capacité à communiquer des informations complexes issues des données et des recommandations aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques de manière claire et accessible

  • Esprit d’équipe efficace, avec une forte capacité à travailler de manière transversale, à interagir avec des parties prenantes diverses et à apporter un soutien fondé sur les données pour les initiatives stratégiques

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Une expérience préalable au sein d’une entreprise SaaS ou d’une organisation d’ingénierie de plateformes est souhaitée

  • La connaissance du portefeuille de produits d’Autodesk et de ses applications dans divers secteurs est un atout

  • Expérience dans l’analyse de produits d’IA/ML ou de type « agentic », y compris les cadres d’évaluation et les compromis en matière de qualité, de réussite des tâches, de latence, de fiabilité ou de coûts

  • Expérience dans le développement de produits de données internes légers, d’applications analytiques ou d’outils basés sur des modèles de langage à grande échelle (LLM) connectés à des données d’entreprise gouvernées

  • Master dans un domaine quantitatif tel que la science des données, les statistiques, les mathématiques ou une discipline connexe

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Belonging

jobs.excerpt: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.
jobs.description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide are chronically absent, making chronic absenteeism one of the highest-stakes challenges districts face. Attendance affects funding, academic outcomes, and long-term student success.

ParentSquare Attendance Plus is our answer: a proactive, relationship-driven solution built directly into the platform districts already use, giving attendance teams tiered data insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place. Since launching, Attendance Plus has earned industry recognition, including Tech & Learning's Best of 2025, and has become one of the fastest-growing lines in the ParentSquare platform.

We are not just creating products; we are creating empowered educators and engaged families to improve the lives of students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and our employees, and we invite you to join us on this journey.

Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who will own the market strategy for Attendance Plus. You'll go deep on the chronic absenteeism problem itself—the research, the district budget cycles, the competitive landscape—and use that expertise to shape where Attendance Plus goes next.

You'll own positioning and messaging for the entire attendance line, translate the needs of attendance clerks, counselors, and district administrators into a narrative that resonates through the whole buying committee, and make the call on which capabilities deserve a full go-to-market push versus a quiet rollout. You'll partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on packaging, pricing, and competitive strategy for the line.

Success in this role means the market understands why Attendance Plus is different, our go-to-market teams know how to win attendance conversations, and customer and competitive insights consistently shape what we build and how we take it to market. You'll be accountable not just for launches but also for helping to grow Attendance Plus as a business.

In This Role You'll:

  • Own the market strategy for Attendance Plus
    • Own positioning and messaging for Attendance Plus, translating chronic absenteeism research and district pain points into a value proposition that’s aligned internally and resonates with superintendents, student services, attendance clerks, and school boards alike.
    • Become an internal expert on the attendance and chronic absenteeism market, including state-level attendance-based funding formulas, district budget cycles, buying dynamics, emerging trends, and the competitive landscape.
    • Partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on pricing, packaging, and segmentation for the line, bringing the voice of the market into build and prioritization conversations.
    • Identify the highest-potential segments, use cases, and growth opportunities for Attendance Plus and develop strategies to reach them.
  • Drive go-to-market for roadmap
    • Work with GTM teams to execute plans for new Attendance Plus capabilities, determining the level of investment a release earns based on its strategic weight to the line.
    • Define launch goals and success metrics, then use adoption, customer feedback, field insights, and market response to evaluate performance and inform what comes next.
    • Turn win/loss analysis and customer research into clear insights on why we win, where we lose, and what those insights mean for our product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Enable the field on attendance
    • Partner with Sales Enablement to help the Sales and Customer Success teams win attendance opportunities, including competitive battlecards, buyer-specific messaging, ROI and outcomes framing, and objection handling.
    • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams to confidently communicate new capabilities, positioning shifts, competitive differentiation, and responses to objections.
  • Lead proactively and drive alignment
    • Drive alignment across the Attendance product team, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership, bringing stakeholders together around a shared understanding of the market and a clear narrative for how we win.
    • Surface strategic risks and opportunities early and turn those insights into clear recommendations.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • Has at least 8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of strategy, positioning, and go-to-market for a specific product or line of business.
  • A proven track record of rapidly scaling a new product line through a complex expansion motion that reaches new buyers within existing customer accounts.
  • Brings exceptional drive, high standards, and a winning mindset, with the ability to earn executive sponsorship while building adoption among frontline stakeholders.
  • Has a track record of using customer, market, and competitive insight to influence product or business decisions.
  • Has strong storytelling and written communication skills and can turn complex customer problems and product capabilities into simple, differentiated narratives.
  • Experience with win/loss analysis, customer research, and translating qualitative insight into clear recommendations.
  • Has genuine interest in the chronic absenteeism problem space and willingness to become the internal expert on it.
  • Is willing to travel to industry events and conferences to spend time with customers, prospects, and the broader education community (approximately 20% travel)

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

We’re looking to hire a Team Lead & Full-Stack Software Developer who demonstrates extreme ownership, sharp problem-solving skills, and exceptional interpersonal abilities to join our Network squad.

You will join a team of 4 Full-Stack Developers (including you), a Product Manager and a Product Designer, dedicated to gaiia’s network modules: Network Monitoring, Incident Management, and Inventory & Fulfillment.

You will be reporting to the VP Eng. At gaiia, Team Leads spend their time between coding (50%) and responsibilities such as technical design, code reviews, and people management (50%). We aim to encourage skilled and passionate developers to continue coding while also enabling their peers to benefit from their technical and people leadership.

In the Network squad, your mission is to own how gaiia sees and controls our customers’ networks: monitoring what’s live, responding when it breaks, provisioning what’s next, and keeping inventory accurate as operators grow. Your squad sits at the boundary between gaiia and a long tail of third-party network vendors, so the quality of your integrations directly shapes how much of a customer’s operation can run on gaiia.

📽 What is your team working on?

Technically speaking, you will work in a serverless ecosystem of microservices deployed on AWS. gaiia is all-in on Typescript, with frontend, backend and infrastructure-as-code all leveraging Typescript.

As part of the Network squad, you will:

  • Build plug-and-play network monitoring and provisioning features by integrating with niche third-party tools, from OLT and CPE vendors to open-access network operators.
  • Build an incident management module that turns network alerts into a clear picture of who’s affected — and keeps their subscribers informed.
  • Model our customers’ physical networks: network sites, topology, and coverage areas.
  • Give operators a reliable source of truth for their IP address space.
  • Design a flexible inventory and fulfillment module that tracks every piece of equipment from the warehouse to the subscriber’s home.
  • Design, develop and deploy GraphQL APIs intended for both internal and external use.
  • Develop, in collaboration with talented designers, delightful interfaces.

🤝 What you’ll own as Team Lead

  • Lead, coach, and develop the developers on your squad through regular 1:1s, feedback, and formal evaluation.
  • Own the technical vision and architecture of the Network Monitoring and Inventory & Fulfillment modules.
  • Raise the bar on code quality, review standards, and engineering productivity within your squad.
  • Partner with your Product Manager on scope, sequencing, and capacity planning.
  • Collaborate with other squads, Customer Success, and the Implementation Team on network-heavy customer onboardings.
  • Participate in hiring and staffing decisions for your squad.

🎖️ Must-haves

  • You have at least five (5) years of experience in Typescript.
  • You have at least two (2) years of experience leading a team of developers.
  • You have experience with the React library.
  • You have experience with Node.js.
  • You have experience in DevOps and AWS services.
  • You are an advanced practitioner of agentic coding, with a track record of using AI to ship production-quality software.
  • You can deal with uncertainty and bring order to fuzzy challenges.
  • You have an outgoing and collaborative personality, eager to work with different stakeholders to solve complex problems.
  • You have a strong product mindset.

🪄 Nice-to-haves

  • You have experience with GraphQL.
  • You have knowledge of networking concepts.
  • You have familiarity with network & telecom technologies such as Calix, Nokia, Adtran, TP-Link, UISP, Tarana, NetBox, RADIUS.
  • You have an interest or expertise in functional programming.

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Role overview

Baker Tilly is seeking a senior consulting leader with deep applied AI expertise to define and lead the next phase of AI activation across our national consulting business. The firm has already established enterprise AI infrastructure and completed significant use-case identification. The opportunity now is to translate that foundation into a clear vision, an actionable portfolio of priorities, and measurable changes in how consulting services are delivered.

This is a business leadership role—not ownership of the underlying AI technology platform or technical delivery organization. The Director must bring enough technical depth to engage credibly with architects, engineers, data professionals, security teams, and platform owners; critically evaluate proposed approaches; challenge assumptions, estimates, constraints, and tradeoffs; and direct technical requests toward the business outcomes Consulting requires. The role will partner closely with the team responsible for OpenAI Enterprise (Anthropic and other tools in consideration), ensuring that technical decisions reflect real consulting workflows, economics, priorities, and adoption needs.

The successful candidate will combine consulting-business fluency, deep applied understanding of modern AI, strategic vision, commercial acumen, rigorous critical thinking, and strong executive influence. They will help practice leaders distinguish meaningful advances from market noise, envision new delivery models, understand revenue and margin implications, and prepare the consulting workforce for sustained change. They must also be comfortable constructively challenging technical teams when recommendations are insufficiently grounded in business value, user needs, practicality, or scale.

Key responsibilities

Set the vision and activation strategy

  • Define and communicate a compelling vision for how AI should reshape Baker Tilly Consulting over the near, medium, and longer term.

  • Translate firm strategy, market developments, and identified use cases into a prioritized Consulting AI roadmap with clear sequencing, dependencies, investment needs, and success measures.

  • Advise consulting executives and practice leaders on where to experiment, scale, pause, or redirect effort based on business value, feasibility, risk, and organizational readiness.

  • Maintain a strong external perspective on advances in generative AI, agentic systems, knowledge technologies, and emerging delivery models, separating durable signals from short-lived hype.

Reimagine consulting services and economics

  • Partner with practice leaders and subject-matter experts to redesign service delivery, workflows, team structures, and client-value propositions around AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities beyond labor efficiency, including improved quality and consistency, just-in-time staff training, stronger knowledge retention and dissemination, accelerated onboarding, enhanced judgment, and scalable access to expertise.

  • Evaluate the implications of AI-enabled delivery for pricing, revenue growth, capacity, utilization, leverage models, profitability, intellectual property, and competitive differentiation.

  • Develop business cases and decision frameworks that connect AI investments to measurable service-line and firm outcomes.

  • Help convert high-value concepts into repeatable methods, accelerators, playbooks, and operating capabilities that can be adopted across practices.

Direct business-to-technology translation and challenge

  • Serve as the primary Consulting business counterpart to the teams that manage enterprise AI platforms, data, integrations, security, architecture, and technical delivery.

  • Convert consulting opportunities into clear, well-structured technical and capability requests, including business requirements, workflow context, priorities, use cases, data needs, integration needs, adoption expectations, constraints, and measurable outcomes.

  • Apply sufficient technical depth to assess proposed architectures and delivery approaches, ask incisive questions, surface hidden assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and challenge recommendations that do not adequately address consulting-business needs.

  • Hold technology partners accountable for translating technical possibilities and limitations into clear business implications, options, risks, costs, dependencies, and decisions.

  • Coordinate with technology, innovation, risk, legal, information security, learning, and other enterprise functions to advance initiatives with appropriate controls and accountability.

Drive adoption and workforce readiness

  • Align the Consulting AI strategy with the firm’s broader workforce upskilling, learning, talent, and change strategies.

  • Define role-based AI capability expectations for consulting professionals, managers, leaders, specialists, and AI champions.

  • Guide the development of practical enablement approaches, including embedded learning, workflow-based training, communities of practice, reusable knowledge assets, office hours, and leader communications.

  • Build and mobilize a network of practice leaders, implementation leads, power users, and advocates who can translate the strategy into local action.

  • Promote responsible experimentation while reinforcing appropriate human review, professional judgment, confidentiality, quality, and risk management.

Create operating discipline and measurable progress

  • Establish a practical intake, prioritization, pilot, measurement, and scale process for Consulting AI initiatives.

  • Define scorecards and KPIs that measure adoption, service-delivery impact, quality, workforce capability, revenue contribution, margin effects, and progress from pilot to scaled use.

  • Provide clear, decision-oriented updates to Consulting leadership on progress, barriers, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes.

  • Capture lessons learned and success stories, and use them to accelerate adoption across service lines without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Leadership profile

  • Visionary but pragmatic: able to imagine materially different ways of delivering consulting services and convert them into executable priorities.

  • Commercially minded: understands how professional services generate revenue and profit, and how changes in effort, leverage, pricing, quality, and speed affect economics.

  • AI-fluent and technically credible: possesses deep applied knowledge of generative AI, agents, retrieval, data, integrations, model capabilities, limitations, and responsible deployment practices—sufficient to engage technical specialists, evaluate proposed solutions, and challenge weak reasoning without serving as the technical delivery owner.

  • Business-to-technology director: can turn business strategy and consulting workflows into precise technical requests, define the outcomes and constraints that matter, and ensure technical teams remain aligned to commercial and operational value.

  • Critical and independent thinker: tests assumptions, probes recommendations, compares alternatives, recognizes unsupported claims, and makes sound decisions when technical and business perspectives diverge.

  • Influential and collaborative: builds trust with executives, practice leaders, practitioners, technologists, and control functions across a complex national firm.

  • Disciplined and discerning: applies sound judgment to balance speed, innovation, professional standards, risk, and long-term scalability.

  • Change-oriented: understands that sustainable AI activation requires shifts in behavior, skills, roles, incentives, and operating models—not merely access to tools.

What success looks like

  • Consulting leaders share and act on a clear, credible vision for AI-enabled service delivery.

  • A focused portfolio of priority initiatives moves from identified opportunity to adoption and scale.

  • AI capability and technical delivery requests are precise, outcome-oriented, appropriately challenged, and aligned with Consulting priorities and enterprise platform strategy.

  • Practices demonstrate measurable improvements in quality, speed, knowledge reuse, workforce readiness, revenue potential, and/or profit margin.

  • Consulting professionals have practical, role-relevant ways to build AI capability and apply it responsibly in their work.

  • Baker Tilly strengthens its competitive position by using AI to enhance expertise, judgment, client value, and scalability—not merely reduce effort.

Role scope and relationships

  • Internal, non-client-facing leadership role supporting the national Consulting business.

  • Works closely with Consulting executive leadership, practice leaders, AI implementation leads, Innovation, Applied AI/technology teams, Learning & Development, Talent, Legal, Risk, Information Security, and other enterprise functions.

  • Does not own enterprise AI infrastructure, architecture, engineering, or technical operations; owns the Consulting business vision, activation agenda, prioritization, business requirements, and value realization—and provides informed direction and challenge to the technology owners.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant professional credential preferred.

  • 12+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, AI-enabled transformation, digital strategy, operating-model design, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI to redesign business processes, knowledge work, service delivery, or professional workflows—not solely managing technology implementation.

  • Strong understanding of consulting or professional-services economics, including pricing, utilization, leverage, capacity, revenue growth, and profitability.

  • Proven ability to develop strategy, build business cases, prioritize a portfolio of opportunities, and move initiatives from concept through adoption and scale.

  • Deep working knowledge of modern AI technologies and solution patterns, including generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, data and integration requirements, model limitations, evaluation, security, and human oversight.

  • Demonstrated ability to engage architects, engineers, data professionals, and platform teams; frame effective technical requests; evaluate proposed approaches and estimates; identify gaps or weak assumptions; and constructively challenge technical recommendations.

  • Exceptional critical-thinking and decision-making skills, including the ability to synthesize incomplete information, assess competing alternatives, distinguish genuine constraints from organizational preferences, and connect technical choices to business consequences.

  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-influence skills, including the ability to communicate complex AI and technology concepts in practical business terms.

  • Experience partnering across business, technology, risk, legal, security, learning, and change-management functions.

  • Strong judgment regarding responsible AI, data sensitivity, client confidentiality, intellectual property, human review, and quality control.

Preferred qualifications

  • Leadership experience within a large, multi-service consulting or professional-services organization.

  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise generative AI platforms such as OpenAI Enterprise, (Anthropic and other tools in consideration), custom GPTs, AI agents, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, or related capabilities.

  • Experience creating or scaling AI-enabled offerings, delivery methods, accelerators, centers of excellence, champion networks, or enterprise adoption programs.

  • Experience leading broad workforce enablement, knowledge-management, or capability-building initiatives.

  • A visible body of applied work, measurable outcomes, or thought leadership demonstrating the ability to turn AI possibilities into sustained business value.

The pay rate range for this job position is $214,100 to $405,900. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

The Vice President, Human Resources is a strategic business leader responsible for developing and executing human resources strategies that support organizational goals, workforce effectiveness, and business growth. This role partners closely with Business Unit leadership to drive talent management, organizational design, employee engagement, leadership development, workforce planning, compensation strategies, and HR operational excellence on a global scale.

The individual serves as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, ensuring alignment between business objectives and people strategies while navigating diverse cultural, legal, and employment environments globally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement global HR strategies aligned with organizational objectives and business priorities.

  • Partner with executive leaders to drive organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.

  • Provide strategic counsel on talent, culture, succession planning, and organizational development.

  • Design and execute talent acquisition, retention, succession planning, and leadership development strategies.

  • Oversee performance management processes that drive accountability, engagement, and results.

  • Partner with leaders to identify workforce capabilities needed for future business growth.

  • Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performance workplace culture.

  • Lead employee relations strategies and resolution of complex workplace issues.

  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation planning, incentive programs, and rewards strategies. Lead or support compensation governance, incentive plan design, market competitiveness reviews, retention proposals, pay equity considerations, and business cases for pay-related decisions.

  • Oversee recruiting process effectiveness and hiring governance, including requisition prioritization, HRBP readiness, hiring-manager guidance, vendor coordination, and alignment with workforce cost controls.

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations. Ensure global workforce actions are planned and executed in line with local employment laws, consultation requirements, severance practices, documentation standards, and regional HR/legal guidance.

  • Monitor HR metrics and key performance indicators to evaluate organizational effectiveness. Provide governance over headcount, hiring activity, and workforce cost commitments to ensure staffing decisions align with business priorities, approved savings targets, and long-term organizational plans.

  • Lead organizational restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and transformation initiatives as needed. Lead the HR workstream for major business transformation and operating model changes, including leadership placement, organization design, employee mapping, role clarity, communication planning, and transition support.

  • Facilitate change management efforts that support adoption of new strategies, structures, and processes.

  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S./B.A.) or equivalent from a college or university in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development or related field required

  • Master’s degree (MBA, MA/MS, MHRM, or equivalent) preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant leadership responsibilities

  • Experience leading HR strategies for global organizations across multiple regions and countries

  • Demonstrated success partnering with senior leadership teams

  • Strong experience in talent management, organizational development, workforce planning, and change management

  • Experience managing geographically dispersed HR teams preferred

  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, and large-scale organizational transformations is highly desirable

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally

Job Overview:

We’re hiring a Pre-Sales Specialist to build and run the outbound engine behind Datakrew’s global growth. You will own a continuous, multi-geography pipeline engine and the qualification discipline that turns what it generates into genuine opportunities, supporting field sales across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia as the team grows. This is currently a single position, and the scope is designed to expand as the field sales team expands. You will be the connective tissue between marketing, field sales, customers, and the technical team, keeping a healthy, self-sustaining pipeline running in every market, not just the ones getting hands-on attention this week.

Own the outbound engine that builds Datakrew’s pipeline across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities:

What will you own from Day 1

  • Own and operate the automated, multi-geography cold outbound engine that builds and sustains pipeline continuously across regions, replacing one-to-one manual outreach with a repeatable, always-on system.
  • Qualify leads into genuine Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) by applying consistent qualification criteria before handing opportunities to field sales.
  • Partner with the Digital Marketing / Marketing Execution function to keep ownership clean: Marketing owns inbound demand-gen and MQL campaigns; this role owns targeted, account-level outbound and qualification into SQL.
  • Maintain CRM and outbound-tooling hygiene with accurate, up-to-date activity, account intelligence, and qualification data
  • Track and report pipeline generation volume, MQL→SQL conversion, and deal velocity across all supported regions.

What this role grows into

As the field sales team expands across regions, the scope of this role expands with it. These become part of the remit as the pipeline engine matures and beds in:

  • Deep account intelligence (buying-committee mapping, competitive positioning, use-case fit) so field sales can run a consultative, insight-led process rather than a generic pitch
  • Techno-commercial proposals tailored to client needs, decision criteria, and business objectives
  • Coordination across customers, field sales, and engineering, with quick-turnaround customisation of proposals and decks as deals progress
  • Continuous learning of Datakrew’s evolving technology and product offerings

Required skills:

  • ​​5–7 years in B2B pre-sales, inside sales, or demand generation, including at least 2 years hands-on building and running automated outbound campaigns. SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience in EV, automotive, or battery tech is a strong plus.
  • Depth in multi-channel outbound (email and LinkedIn) using email automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), covering list building, cadence design, copy testing, and deliverability. This is core to the role, not incidental.
  • Aptitude for account research and building actionable account intelligence (buying committee, competitive landscape, use-case fit). Depth here can be developed in the role.
  • Strong qualification discipline, able to apply consistent criteria to convert leads into genuine SQLs rather than pass volume downstream.
  • Working knowledge of software integration concepts, APIs, and hardware-software integration.
  • Strong techno-commercial acumen, able to translate technical concepts into business language and vice versa.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, with cultural adaptability across geographies (UK, Europe, Southeast Asia).
  • Comfort with outbound copywriting and A/B testing of messaging and cadence to improve response rates.
  • Ability to build repeatable process, this role's remit is designed to grow in scope alongside field sales as the team expands, so process discipline matters as much as individual execution
  • High ownership, quick learning, and comfort working independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-geography environment.

Good to have:

  • Prior experience engaging with EV OEMs, automotive fleets, or IoT platforms
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce) and data enrichment / prospecting tools(e.g., Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
  • Awareness of email deliverability best practices (domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC basics) and outreach compliance considerations (GDPR, CAN-SPAM) across regions, since this role's outbound engine spans UK/Europe and Asia.
  • Exposure to AI-driven analytics or SaaS-based platforms.

Why Join Us:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Direct, visible impact on strategic accounts and global growth, this role sits at the centre of the GTM engine, not on its edge.
  • Learning, advancement, and leadership opportunities within a cutting-edge AI + IoT company.
  • Flexible work setup and autonomy in execution.

About Datakrew

Datakrew is revolutionizing EV fleet intelligence with cutting-edge IoT/AI solutions. Our flagship solution, OXRED Platform Suite, provides deep insights into vehicle fleet performance and diagnostics. Datakrew is backed by leading global investors including Beenext and SG Growth Capital,we serve customers across 8+ countries in Asia, including Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, and India, and are now expanding into the UK and Europe. Our goal is to serve one million EVs within the next 5 years, and as a company, touch a billion lives with technology.

Role Summary: The Managing Director of Security Architecture & Engineering is a senior cybersecurity and technology leader responsible for architecting secure enterprise technology and delivering the cybersecurity platforms and services that protect The Cigna Group at speed and scale.

This role ensures that security is embedded by design across cloud, application, infrastructure, and emerging technology environments- while leading the engineering and delivery of cybersecurity platforms that enable protection, detection, response, identity, cloud security, and cyber operations at enterprise scale.

Partners with CIO, CISO, and enterprise technology leaders to align security architecture, secure engineering practices, and cybersecurity platform investments with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and the evolving threat landscape. Fundamentally, this role is accountable both for influencing how the enterprise builds technology securely and for delivering the security platforms and services that enable Cybersecurity to protect the company at speed and scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Security Architecture & Engineering Leadership

  • Lead Security Architecture & Engineering as an enterprise capability, that advances secure-by-design technology practices and delivers cybersecurity engineering capabilities that protect the enterprise.

  • Establish and govern security architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns across applications, cloud, infrastructure, and platform services.

  • Ensure security is embedded early and consistently across the technology delivery lifecycle through secure-by-design and DevSecOps practices.

  • Drive engineering outcomes that are scalable, resilient, automated, and aligned to modern cloud-native and platform-based architectures.

Cybersecurity Platform Engineering & Delivery

  • Own the strategy, architecture, roadmap, modernization, and delivery of core cybersecurity platforms and services that enable enterprise security operations, reduce complexity, and improve risk outcomes.

  • Lead engineering teams responsible for designing, implementing, integrating, automating, and lifecycle-managing security technologies, reusable services, APIs, and engineering capabilities across identity, endpoint, cloud, application, network, data, detection, and response domains.

  • Establish platform engineering practices and metrics that improve reliability, scalability, performance, resiliency, adoption, operational efficiency, and user experience across the cybersecurity technology portfolio.

Cloud & Platform Security

  • Define and advance secure cloud adoption strategies across multi-cloud and hybrid environments (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Partner with cloud, infrastructure, and application leaders to ensure secure configuration, architecture, and operation of platforms.
  • Lead the development of guardrails and controls that enable speed while enforcing security and compliance requirements.
  • Promote infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, automated security controls across environments, and reusable cloud-native security patterns across environments.

AI, Emerging Technology & Innovation

  • Establish security architecture and controls for AI/GenAI solutions, including model governance, data protection, and responsible AI practices.

  • Partner with enterprise AI and data teams to enable secure adoption of advanced analytics, machine learning, and automation capabilities.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and integrate them into security and engineering strategies in a way that balances innovation with risk management.

  • Drive AI-enabled security capabilities, automation, and engineering solutions that enhance detection, response, security operations, decision-making, and cyber defense outcomes.

Enterprise Engagement & Risk Alignment

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior technology and business leaders on security architecture, cloud risk, and investment priorities.

  • Ensure alignment of architecture and engineering decisions with enterprise cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with risk, compliance, and audit teams to ensure appropriate controls and governance are embedded across platforms.

  • Provide clear, executive-level communication on security posture, architecture direction, and key risks.

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator is responsible for building and expanding AMO's national clinical network by identifying, engaging, and developing partnerships with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and healthcare organizations that support clinical education programs.

This is a highly results-driven role designed for professionals who already possess a strong foundation in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, or credentialing and are motivated to make an immediate impact. While AMO provides training on our systems, processes, and platform, successful candidates bring industry knowledge, professional judgment, and the confidence to quickly operate with a high level of independence. The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator owns a strategic recruitment pipeline from initial outreach through onboarding readiness, balancing relationship-building with measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is driven by thoughtful execution—not simply outreach volume. High performers know how to prioritize opportunities, build trusted relationships, and consistently convert conversations into long-term clinical partnerships that support AMO's continued growth.

This position is best suited for professionals who thrive in an environment built on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, thinking strategically, and delivering measurable results will excel in this role.

 

While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, or Texas.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a hands-on AWS threat hunter with strong technical and analytical skills, genuine curiosity about cloud attack techniques, experience hunting for evidence of adversarial activity, and the ability to develop defensive capabilities to counter them. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of hands-on threat hunting experience in cloud environments, preferably AWS.

You will work with complex, high-profile organizations across the globe, conducting threat hunting in cloud environments to identify active and historical threats, reviewing cloud control plane configurations, and providing technical recommendations to reduce adversary opportunity in target environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Utilize the Falcon platform and threat intelligence to analyze cloud logs and identify historical and active threats.

  • Baseline and review cloud security configurations, looking for anomalies associated with threat activity.

  • Develop queries and scripts to work with large volumes of data, including correlating data across multiple sources and identifying outliers that may be indicative of threat activity.

  • Identify identity and control plane configurations that may expose cloud environments to threats and unauthorized access.

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of client projects, including project management, communication, status updates, and task assignment.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings for key stakeholders, including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel.

What You’ll Need:

Technical Skills:

  • An in-depth understanding of cloud adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), including attack path chaining and enriching data with threat intelligence.

  • An in-depth understanding of the AWS platform, including the following domains: logging, identity, networking, workload security, data security, and multi-account management practices.

  • A solid grasp of AWS security architecture patterns, including log management architecture and automation patterns leveraging AWS-native services.

  • A strong knowledge of security configuration and architecture of CI/CD pipelines

  • A strong ability to write modular scripts and software tools in Python or Go to work with AWS services and Falcon APs.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Communication Skills:

  • A strong ability to verbally communicate technical concepts and findings in plain English to technical and non-technical audiences, including CISO-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent technical writing skills and ability to produce high-quality written reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and CrowdStrike clients.

  • Attention to details, time management, delegation. This is a consulting role and excellent organizational skills are non-negotiable.

We care about what you know and what you can do, not the specific path you took to get here. Strong candidates will have built real depth in cloud platforms and security over time - whether through years in dedicated security roles, a background in cloud engineering or DevOps that shifted toward threat hunting, or any other route that got them to the same place. What matters is that the knowledge is solid and the skills are demonstrable.

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
