jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets.
jobs.description:
Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets. We combine deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure to unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

As we scale, we are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and manage the infrastructure that connects our marketing activity with sales. This is a hands-on role focused on making HubSpot a powerful operating system for understanding contact engagement, identifying intent signals, delivering relevant nurture, and helping our sales team engage the right people at the right time.

This is not an inbound lead-generation or MQL-focused role. The objective is to understand how contacts are engaging with Tangible over time — what they are reading, which campaigns they respond to, what they do on our website, and other relevant signals — so that we can identify increasing levels of interest and act quickly.

You will own the day-to-day marketing operations architecture in HubSpot, while also managing nurture campaigns, marketing messaging and the operational side of content. You will work closely with leadership and Sales to ensure our marketing activity generates useful signals and actionable intelligence, rather than simply producing more leads.

Tasks

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

  • Own and manage Tangible's HubSpot marketing operations architecture.
  • Build, maintain and optimise HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Ensure HubSpot is correctly structured to capture and connect engagement data across marketing channels.
  • Develop robust processes for tracking contact engagement across email, website activity, content consumption, campaigns and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
  • Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Engagement Scoring & Intent Signals

  • Build and continuously refine contact engagement scoring based on meaningful behavioural signals.
  • Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
  • Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
  • Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner.
  • Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
  • Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
  • Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Nurture & Marketing Automation

  • Design, build and manage nurture programmes in HubSpot.
  • Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
  • Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
  • Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Messaging & Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Sales to understand the messaging and information they need to engage prospects effectively.
  • Develop and manage marketing messaging for nurture campaigns, email campaigns and other targeted communications.
  • Support Sales with relevant outreach messaging, follow-ups, campaign assets and other enablement materials.
  • Use engagement data and audience behaviour to inform messaging and help Sales personalise outreach.
  • Help Sales understand how to interpret and act on engagement signals coming from HubSpot.
  • Identify content and messaging that can support specific sales conversations and commercial priorities.

Content Operations
Content is not the primary responsibility of this role. Instead, you will ensure that Tangible's content is properly integrated into our marketing operations infrastructure.

  • Ensure content assets, reports, newsletters and other marketing activity are properly connected to HubSpot.
  • Make sure content engagement can be tracked at the contact level and incorporated into relevant segmentation and scoring.
  • Work with the wider team to ensure campaigns and content launches are set up correctly from an operational perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to use existing content within nurture programmes and sales journeys.
  • Report on which content is generating meaningful engagement and signals of interest.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Build clear reporting around contact engagement, campaign performance, nurture activity and sales signals.
  • Provide leadership and Sales with actionable insight rather than vanity metrics.
  • Identify patterns in contact behaviour and engagement that can inform marketing and sales activity.
  • Measure the effectiveness of nurture programmes, scoring models and marketing campaigns.
  • Continuously improve the marketing operations infrastructure based on data, feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and Sales to align marketing operations with commercial priorities.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure engagement signals are genuinely useful in day-to-day prospecting and relationship management.
  • Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
  • Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years' experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related B2B marketing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing HubSpot architecture. This is a must-have.
  • Demonstrable experience building and managing HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Experience designing and managing engagement or behavioural scoring models.
  • A strong understanding of how behavioural signals can be used to prioritise contacts and improve Sales engagement.
  • Experience building and optimising nurture campaigns and automated customer/prospect journeys.
  • Comfortable working across Marketing and Sales and translating commercial requirements into practical marketing-operations solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contact data, segmentation, lifecycle management and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to analyse engagement data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong copywriting and messaging skills, particularly for B2B audiences and nurture campaigns.
  • Commercially minded, with an understanding that marketing operations should ultimately help Sales have better conversations with the right people.
  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable owning the function independently and building processes from the ground up.
  • Experience in private markets, PE/VC, financial services or another complex B2B environment is preferred.

What You'll Own

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You will be responsible for making sure Tangible's marketing infrastructure works properly — from the underlying HubSpot architecture through to scoring, segmentation, nurture and the signals delivered to Sales.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys building systems, understanding how people behave, and turning data into action. You should be equally comfortable getting deep into a HubSpot workflow and working with Sales on how a particular engagement signal should change their approach.

You will have the opportunity to build the marketing operations function as Tangible scales, with significant ownership over the systems, processes and programmes that connect marketing activity to revenue.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Conversion Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.

jobs.excerpt: Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas a desafios técnicos, que se identifiquem com um ambiente dinâmico e diverso, e que combinem profundidade técnica com visão de negócio para atuar como referência especializada na operação de segurança de uma instituição financeira S2.
jobs.description:
Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas a desafios técnicos, que se identifiquem com um ambiente dinâmico e diverso, e que combinem profundidade técnica com visão de negócio para atuar como referência especializada na operação de segurança de uma instituição financeira S2.

A posição atua como referência técnica (trilha de especialista) na Gerência de Operações de Segurança (SecOps), liderando tecnicamente projetos complexos, definindo padrões, arquiteturas e estratégias de proteção cibernética e orientando as equipes na adoção das melhores práticas de mercado. Atua integrada à 1ª linha de defesa e em articulação com a Arquitetura/CoE de Segurança e a 2ª linha (CISO), com escopo em Arquitetura de Segurança, definição de padrões, projetos estratégicos, avaliação de riscos complexos, consultoria técnica especializada e evolução tecnológica.

Terá foco na engenharia de segurança, que visa absorver de forma estruturada os handovers de projetos e a evolução tecnológica vinda da 2ª linha e da Arquitetura, evitando que a engenharia concorra com a demanda operacional do dia a dia.

O desafio central é elevar a régua técnica de segurança e sustentar a evolução para uma defesa proativa e risk-based, orientada a frameworks de mercado (NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Benchmarks e MITRE ATT&CK), sob os requisitos do BACEN, da Resolução CMN nº 5.274 e da LGPD. A posição tem, ainda, potencial de assumir a Coordenação quando a equipe for ampliada.

Referência técnica e evolução tecnológica

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de segurança, definindo arquiteturas e padrões corporativos de proteção cibernética;
  • Avaliar riscos tecnológicos associados a novas iniciativas e atuar como consultor interno para temas complexos;
  • Promover a inovação e a adoção de novas tecnologias de proteção, elaborando estratégias de evolução tecnológica e de maturidade;
  • Influenciar decisões corporativas relacionadas à segurança, sustentando baselines, hardening (CIS Benchmarks) e a remediação estrutural de vulnerabilidades comprovadas em testes de Red/White Team;
  • Orientar tecnicamente analistas e coordenadores em temas especializados (ex.: IAM/PAM, cloud security, proteção de dados, detecção e resposta, AI Security);
  • Representar a organização junto a fornecedores, auditorias e fóruns técnicos especializados.

Conformidade, riscos e sustentação

  • Assegurar aderência aos padrões, políticas e requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis (Resolução CMN nº 5.274, BACEN e LGPD);
  • Apoiar a análise de causa raiz de incidentes relevantes e a definição de soluções para problemas de alta complexidade;
  • Contribuir para a produção de evidências técnicas e para a resolução de apontamentos de auditoria interna, externa e reguladores.
  • Formação superior em Cibersegurança, Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência técnica em Segurança da Informação e Segurança Cibernética, atuando como referência especialista em um ou mais domínios de SecOps;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte; experiência no sistema financeiro é diferencial relevante;
  • Domínio técnico de tecnologias de segurança: IAM/PAM/MFA, EDR/XDR, SSE, Cloud Security, ITDR, proteção de dados e integrações SIEM/SOAR;
  • Experiência em gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening (CIS Benchmarks), resposta a incidentes e arquitetura de segurança;
  • Domínio de frameworks de mercado: NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Benchmarks e MITRE ATT
  • Conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório aplicável: BACEN, Resolução CMN nº 5.274 e LGPD;
  • Capacidade de comunicação técnica e de influência, com histórico de condução de projetos e definição de padrões;
  • Desejáveis certificações técnicas avançadas: CISSP, OSCP, GIAC (GCIH/GCIA/GPEN), CCSP e certificações de plataforma (ex.: CyberArk, CrowdStrike, cloud pública).

jobs.excerpt: Ideal start timeline: September 2026 Role status: Exempt Compensation: Our target hiring range is $105,000-$140,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $7,000 bonus.
jobs.description:
Ideal start timeline: September 2026

Role status: Exempt

Compensation: Our target hiring range is $105,000-$140,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $7,000 bonus. Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

Campminder’s Flexible Working Location: Our employees have the option to work 100% remotely within the United States or their choice of days at home and at our office in Boulder, Colorado. We host a variety of all-company hybrid meetings and social events. We require anybody working remotely to have a very reliable, high-speed internet connection.

We know the best people can choose to work anywhere.

Here’s a few reasons why 100+ of them choose Campminder:

  • With 20+ years experience of serving the industry through its digital transformation, we’re stable, profitable, and have developed a loyal customer base (that continues to grow).
  • We build software for summer camps, an industry that enables meaningful experiences for kids.
  • We work on interesting, ambitious projects that create real value for our clients.
  • We know our team members feel their work has an impact on the organization’s purpose.
  • At the same time, we are genuinely committed to work/life balance. Our team members feel they have the flexibility to take time off when needed and feel supported in making use of flexible working arrangements.
  • We invest in emerging technology and cutting-edge leadership and are proud to take an "AI-Enabled" approach in our solutions.
  • We’ve been listed on Outside Magazine’s 50 Best Places to Work for 8 consecutive years for our values-led culture and employee experience.

This role’s mission & overview:

Camp directors judge us by how confidently and independently they can run their operations in our platform, from initial launch through every season that follows. This role owns that experience through two equally important pillars: Implementation and Learning. You'll set the strategic direction and roadmap for both, keeping our white-glove onboarding sharp for our most complex accounts while building the content, curriculum, and systems that let smaller camps get up and running largely on their own. As we modernize our platform, the roadmap you set here becomes the foundation for how every camp learns our system, for years to come.

As a Manager of Learning & Implementation, you will:

  • Own the strategic direction and roadmap for both Implementation and Learning, deciding what gets built, in what order, and why, grounded in data rather than instinct.
  • Manage and develop your team of implementation specialists and learning content specialists, setting clear priorities and standards and holding people accountable to them.
  • Direct execution of Implementation, guiding your team's priorities and standards for how camps move through technical setup and onboarding.
  • Direct execution of Learning, guiding your team's priorities for the curriculum, self-serve content, and knowledge base infrastructure that let classic and small camps launch with far less hands-on support.
  • Design learning programs and implementation processes built to flex, not just scale, so they hold up as the UI evolves and new technologies (including AI-driven tools) reshape how camps interact with the platform.
  • Partner across Support, Success, Sales, and Product — working especially closely with Product to keep Learning ahead of platform changes, so new features and modernization efforts launch with the training and content camps need already in place, not built after the fact.
  • Define and report on the metrics that prove both pillars are working, from launch quality and time-to-value to support case deflection, and adjust the roadmap based on what the data shows.

We think a successful candidate will bring:

  • You've managed people, including motivating a team, holding people accountable to clear expectations, and managing a budget responsibly.
  • You've set strategy for an area of a business, translating goals into priorities, tradeoffs, and a clear plan for how the work should move forward.
  • You have experience with Learning and Implementation roles in SaaS businesses, and are familiar with best practices in those disciplines, including how AI is changing customer onboarding, enablement, and learning.
  • You've used real data to set priorities, make tradeoffs, and explain why one path should come before another, even if you have not owned the full roadmap for a function before.
  • You know how to define what success should look like, track whether the work is having the intended impact, and adjust your approach when the data says something is not working.
  • You've represented your work in a high-stakes conversation, whether that's with a senior leader, a frustrated customer, or a cross-functional group with competing priorities.

Our Interview Process:

  1. 45 min - interview with People & Culture
  2. 60 min - interview with Hiring Manager
  3. Phase 3:
    1. 60 min - interview with a Client Services Leader
    2. 60 min - interview with Head of Product Insights

  • Robust medical, dental, and vision coverage options with generous employer contributions, plus a $500 employer HSA contribution for HSA-compatible plans
  • Ability to choose where you work - remotely, in the office, or a mix!

  • 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for all new parents, including via adoption, surrogacy, and foster care
  • 401(k) with 4% company matching

  • Company-paid subscriptions, training, and support for using AI professionally and personally. We have a team dedicated to enabling our AI capabilities for our team members and our customers!

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply:

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you!

We encourage applications from parents, parents-to-be, and those responsible for the caretaking of others. We offer paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents (including for adoption, surrogacy, and foster care placement) and paid loss leave to recover from miscarriage or stillbirth. The company's HSA and wellness allowance contributions may be used toward childcare, eldercare, adoption fees, and fertility treatments like IVF, among other expenses.

You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.

  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

jobs.description:
Yopeso has been developing a diverse range of software products, from large-scale applications to smaller solutions, for 20 years. With a growing team of over 300 employees across five locations, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of growth, transparency, and professionalism.

At Yopeso, we value authenticity, curiosity, and ambition. These values drive us to build strong connections within our community and with our partners, ensuring trust, integrity, and transparency in all our business practices. We strive to maintain the highest professional standards and continuously challenge ourselves to develop high-quality, high-performance, and secure software solutions.

Our approach is rooted in efficient collaboration among passionate professionals working in agile teams. Guided by curiosity and ambition, we strive to create products that are meaningful and impactful, while remaining true to our authentic selves.

Requirements

We are looking for a Post-Merger Integration Manager to lead the successful integration of acquired companies and build a repeatable PMI capability for future acquisitions.

You will own the integration program from pre-close planning and Day 1 readiness through operational and cultural integration, coordinating leaders across the acquiring and acquired organizations. Your focus will be on aligning people, processes, operations, culture, and ways of working to ensure the acquisition delivers its intended business value.

This is a business and organizational integration role, rather than a hands-on technical systems role. Functional leaders across IT, Finance, People/HR, and other areas remain accountable for their respective workstreams, while you own the overall integration plan, governance, coordination, risks, and dependencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integration planning and execution, from pre-close and Day 1 through stabilization and full integration.

  • Develop and manage the integration roadmap, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success metrics across functional workstreams.

  • Act as the key integration point between senior leadership, functional teams, and the acquired organization.

  • Coordinate People/HR, Finance, IT, Operations, and other workstreams to ensure alignment and effective execution.

  • Identify and resolve organizational, cultural, communication, and process gaps across teams and geographies.

  • Track integration risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions, bringing leadership clear recommendations and solutions.

  • Support the realization of expected synergies, efficiencies, and other deal value.

  • Facilitate integration meetings, workshops, and leadership updates to maintain alignment and accountability.

  • Support due diligence and pre-close planning for future acquisitions, bringing an integration perspective to deal evaluation.

  • Build and continuously improve PMI playbooks, templates, governance processes, and lessons learned to make future integrations faster and more effective.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in post-merger integration, M&A, business transformation, or large-scale organizational change.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects across multiple teams, countries, or locations.

  • Strong understanding of organizational, operational, cultural, and people-related aspects of integration.

  • Experience working with senior leadership and managing stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Genuine cross-cultural fluency and experience working with international teams.

  • Strong program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and adapting as priorities change.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with fluent written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to support integration activities.

  • Experience in technology, software, or professional services.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison - Ophthalmology - West
jobs.excerpt: The EVERSANA Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison functions as a highly trained, field-based, scientific expert in ophthalmology, particularly retinal disease, who engages health care professionals and leaders in clinical, scientific, value-based care and research-based peer to peer scientific exchange around our client’s product.
jobs.description:
The EVERSANA Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison functions as a highly trained, field-based, scientific expert in ophthalmology, particularly retinal disease, who engages health care professionals and leaders in clinical, scientific, value-based care and research-based peer to peer scientific exchange around our client’s product.

Following regulatory and corporate guidelines, they will facilitate and build scientific relationships and collaborations with scientific communities. This position interacts with local, regional, and national Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and health care practitioners (HCPs), as well as professional societies and organizations. The MSL will need to be fully engaged with pertinent professional societies, as well as other value-based institutions and associations including ophthalmology and optometry clinics and retinal specialists that are involved with the treatment of neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD). The MSL will be the field based scientific expert regarding our client’s product.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Function as the primary medical point of contact in geographic area.
  • Maintain clinical and scientific expertise in ophthalmology with specific focus in standards of care related to the treatment of neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD), commonly known as wet AMD.
  • Engage in well informed, compliant, robust, and accurate scientific peer exchange around the treatment of wet AMD, and the science our client’s product.
  • Engage in medical & scientific exchange with the medical/scientific community including advisory boards.
  • Conduct pre-launch KOL profiling efforts to enhance depth of product/disease/scientific knowledge. Facilitate top account/institution profiling efforts to enhance understanding of patient care pathways, including treatment protocol development and novel therapies.
  • Develop and track Strategic KOL engagement plans - identify, develop, and maintain long-term collaborative relationships with KOLs within assigned region.
  • Support health systems, population health leaders, and medical quality professionals by offering clinical, public health, medical quality, and other scientific information to help guide medical decisions
  • Deliver clinical and scientific presentations to healthcare providers, health systems, and medical group leadership, as well as community/advocacy groups.
  • Build relationships and assist in the development of key opinion leaders.
  • Build relationships with key decision makers in health systems, medical groups, healthcare provider offices, state departments of public health, advocacy organizations, and national/regional professional societies.
  • Provide insight into market trends and clinical intelligence.
  • Collaborates with the Medical Affairs leadership in the development of key opinion leaders.
  • Collaborate with clients and thought leaders on a national, regional, and local level to develop clinical insights that support medical research associated with new and existing products.
  • Supports implementation team as needed.
  • Identify, attend and report on local/regional educational events such as national symposia and scientific/clinical meetings and CME events.
  • Manage time and travel expense budget for scientific exchange and clinical education activities within dedicated regions.
  • Demonstrate excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as effective presentation skills
  • Ability to work well independently and manage time effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on producing high-quality work.
  • Strong verbal and written communication; public speaking skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures
  • Responsible for all clinical program requests and for unsolicited requests for information.
  • May collaborate with R&D Team to support sites and investigators participating in the company-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Work collaboratively and compliantly with commercial colleagues to assure product strategic imperatives are represented cross functionally in account engagement.
  • Respond to and document unsolicited requests for information on clinical initiatives.
  • May serve as a resource for investigator-initiated trial (IIT) proposals.
  • Provide internal teams with feedback and insights from interactions with KOLs.
  • Represent our client at medical meetings through Medical Affairs Scientific Booth coverage and other related activities.
  • Attend congresses as appropriate and develop meaningful internal reports of the congresses covered.
  • Adhere to corporate SOPs and ensure vigilant compliance with relevant legal and regulatory guidelines governing scientific interactions with physicians and healthcare professionals across all activities, including those related to clinical trials, scientific interactions with internal and external groups, and responses to unsolicited requests for medical/scientific information.
  • Consistently demonstrate a high standard of excellence in the management of assigned territory while also contributing to the success of colleagues and the MSL team.
  • Willingness to contribute to the achievement of organizational goals beyond the borders of a geographic territory.
  • Be solidly versed in the clinical data such that the full range of innovative science, clinical, outcome, economic and value aspects of our client’s products can be appreciated by the healthcare practitioner, formulary member or payer.
  • Provide medical support, clinical input, and/or training for internal teams as requested.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • An advanced degree (e.g., OD, PharmD, PhD, MD, MSN, DNP, or NP/PA) is required.
  • MSL: A minimum of 2 years previous MSL experience necessary with a minimum of 1 year in ophthalmology with working knowledge of retinal disorders.
  • Sr. MSL: A minimum of 5 years of pharma experience and 3 years of rare disease, ophthalmology experience.
  • Prior product launch experience desired.
  • Exhibits the highest level of scientific, business, and clinical acumen with excellent communication and networking skills.
  • The ability to interpret and present scientific data to engage KOLs.
  • Working knowledge of standards of care for prostate cancer required.
  • Previous experience sharing scientific content with payer systems is highly desirable.
  • Working knowledge of Ophthalmology screening and wellness programs is strongly desired.
  • Ability to present complex scientific and value and evidence data to payors and/or formulary committees is required.
  • Working knowledge of institutions and clinics in selected geographies is expected.
  • Excellent written and oral presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel frequently (70%) with overnight stays (e.g., KOL meetings, site locations, internal meetings, medical meetings and congresses, training).

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

jobs.title: Contract Senior Clinical Research Associate
jobs.excerpt: ProTrials is a women-owned, WBENC-certified Contract Research Organization (CRO) that has been a trusted partner in clinical research since 1996.
jobs.description:
ProTrials is a women-owned, WBENC-certified Contract Research Organization (CRO) that has been a trusted partner in clinical research since 1996. Founded with a clear mission to deliver high-quality, experienced, and ethical services, we’ve supported research behind innovative treatments in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries.
Our people are the heart of everything we do. We believe great work happens when team members feel valued, supported, and empowered. At ProTrials, you’ll join a collaborative community committed to making a meaningful impact on global health.
We are excited to connect with skilled individuals who share our passion for advancing clinical research with care, integrity, and excellence.
ABOUT THE JOB
ProTrials is seeking a Contract Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our team.
The Contract Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) plays an integral part in the successful monitoring and management of clinical trials. Responsibilities of a Contract Sr. CRA include ensuring clinical trials are conducted, recorded, and reported in accordance with the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), ICH GCP, and all applicable regulatory requirements. Contract Sr. CRAs may be required to travel up to 65%.

HERE IS WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Monitor clinical studies of investigational and approved products that have been determined to satisfy a medical need and/or offer a commercial benefit, including qualification, initiation, interim, and close-out site visits
  • Manage and train site personnel on therapeutic area, protocol requirements, proper source documentation, and case report form completion
  • Manage and track the preparation and return of investigational supplies at individual sites
  • Monitor and document investigational product dispensing, inventory, and reconciliation
  • Monitor and document laboratory sample storage and shipment
  • Monitor trial by reviewing and reporting on the following: site enrollment and termination updates, monitoring visits, protocol deviations/exceptions, serious adverse events, and laboratory abnormalities
  • Review source data and case report forms for accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the data, and identify and resolve ongoing data issues
  • Review data queries and listings, and work with study centers to resolve data discrepancies
  • Review regulatory documentation for accuracy and completeness, and support study centers with regulatory issues
  • Maintain complete and accurate study files and review files to ensure all appropriate documentation is present
  • Maintain consistent and timely contact with the study centers, investigators, coordinators, client personnel, and other individuals involved in clinical trials
  • Serve as a resource for project team members including supporting CRA I and CRA II staff by providing solutions to resolve issues

HERE IS WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

  • RN or Bachelor and/or advanced degree in biological sciences or related field, or equivalent combination of relevant experience, education or training, and previous CRA experience demonstrating career growth in the CRA position

jobs.excerpt: As Marqeta’s FP&A Manager, GTM Finance — Credit Products, you will focus on Marqeta's credit business by partnering with Sales, Legal, Product, Credit Risk, and Capital Markets to model pricing, evaluate profitability, and structure deals that win business while protecting unit economics.
jobs.description:
As Marqeta’s FP&A Manager, GTM Finance — Credit Products, you will focus on Marqeta's credit business by partnering with Sales, Legal, Product, Credit Risk, and Capital Markets to model pricing, evaluate profitability, and structure deals that win business while protecting unit economics. You'll flex in on debit and prepaid as needed, but credit is where you'll spend the majority of your time.

Credit deals are not debit deals. They come with different revenue mechanics, cost structures, and stakeholders — and modeling them well means understanding life-of-loan economics, vintage performance, capital efficiency, and revenue share splits across multiple parties. A meaningful part of this role is partnering with Marqeta's credit function to build financial models that help secure new bank partnerships and capital providers, crafting the projections, scenario analyses, and economic narratives that go in front of prospective partners.

You won't be on the sidelines forecasting — you'll be in the room helping Sales shape deals in real time, pressure-testing assumptions on interchange splits, loss curves, and program economics. You'll be joining a tight-knit deal desk team that shares context, shares wins, and shares the load. The work moves fast, and the team is how we keep up.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely anywhere within the U.S. or from our local Oakland office. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

  • Serve as the financial partner to Sales on live credit deals — modeling the full economic stack: interchange, finance charges, fees, rewards costs, cost of funds, expected losses, network fees, and sponsor bank revenue share
  • Build deal-level models that capture the full life-of-portfolio economics — not just first-year interchange, but how the deal performs as the portfolio matures, revolve rates stabilize, and losses curve in
  • Partner with Credit Risk and Capital Markets teams to make sure every deal model reflects realistic loss assumptions, funding costs, and capital efficiency considerations

  • Model multi-party revenue share structures across program manager, sponsor bank, processor, and network — and stress-test how the splits behave at different volume and performance tiers
  • Lead deal review meetings on credit deals with sales leadership, translating complex credit economics into clear, actionable recommendations that help close business without compromising margin
  • Build and continuously sharpen the credit-specific deal desk toolkit — pricing benchmarks, loss-curve templates, capital-cost calculators, vintage performance models, and the dashboards that bring them together
  • Help Sales speak credibly about credit economics with prospects — from sophisticated fintech buyers building their second card program, to commercial customers thinking about a credit product for the first time
  • Stay close to credit product evolution, regulatory developments (Reg Z, CFPB, state usury), and competitive dynamics in the credit issuing space — and bring that intelligence into every deal

Who You Are

  • A genuinely strong financial mind. You're fluent in modeling, comfortable with ambiguity in the numbers, and you know enough about credit risk modeling and capital markets concepts to be a credible partner to those teams
  • Thrive under pressure. Credit deals don't wait, and they don't simplify. You're energized by a fast pace, multiple priorities, and the occasional fire drill — and you deliver accurate work even when the clock is loud
  • AI-curious and hungry to experiment. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work, you have opinions about what's overhyped and what's actually useful, and you see AI as leverage to do more — not a threat or a checkbox

American Specialty Health Incorporated (ASH) is seeking a Sr Platform Engineer I to join our to join our Platform Engineering and DevOps organization.

The purpose of this role is to serve as an individual contributor responsible for implementing and contributing to the design and evolution of capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient public cloud adoption and software delivery. This role supports platform engineering practices, developer self-service, and contributes to the continuous improvement of cloud reliability, automation, and engineering standards to accelerate business outcomes through the simplification of software product delivery.

Remote Worker Guidelines

  • Remote Worker Guidelines: This position will be trained remotely and must be able to work from home (WFH) in a designated work area with company-provided technology equipment. This WFH position requires you have a stable connection to your Internet Service Provider with the ability to participate by video in online meetings over a reliable and consistent network. The internet connection must have a consistent 50 down/10 up Mbps minimum internet speed. 100 down/20 up is recommended to support higher quality video meetings.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Engineering Delivery
    • Implement and contribute to the design of platform environments across cloud compute, storage, networking, and runtime layers that leverage IaaS and PaaS products on the Azure public cloud.
    • Deploy and operate containerized platform-native runtime services.
    • Implement infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
    • Develop, maintain, and enhance reusable platform components and automation frameworks based on established platform patterns and standards.

    Platform Efficiency, Reliability, Security & Governance

    • Implement security controls and policy enforcement defined by platform standards.
    • Implement identity, access, and secrets management patterns.
    • Enable compliance and governance through automated guardrails.
    • Implement monitoring and logging solutions.
    • Implement and support redundant, fault tolerant, and automated recovery mechanisms that leverage zonal and multi-region cloud tenancy patterns.
    • Monitor platform performance and contribute to cost optimization efforts.

    Software Product Delivery Enablement & Developer Experience

    • Enable consistent application deployment patterns and workflows.
    • Support, build, and enhance developer tooling and CI/CD platform capabilities.
    • Implement and maintain self-service templates and contribute to the evolution of golden paths.
    • Contribute to abstraction layers and APIs for infrastructure and platform services.

    Operations & Continuous Improvement

    • Troubleshoot platform and infrastructure issues.
    • Perform root cause analysis.
    • Collaborate with team members and share knowledge.

    Integration & Eventing Platform Enablement

    • Implement and support messaging, eventing, and API capabilities.
    • Enable event-driven and asynchronous communication patterns across systems.
    • Utilize and contribute to reusable integration patterns for application and platform services.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience required. If equivalent experience, High School Diploma required.
  • 3 years experience in cloud platform engineering, software engineering, systems engineering or DevOps roles; with hands-on experience implementing and supporting scalable, distributed systems across IaaS, PaaS, AI, and container-based environments required.

  • Experience working within and contributing to DevOps/DevSecOps practices, including collaboration across development, security, and operations teams required.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex systems, improve platform reliability, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives required.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management concepts and securing platform resources in cloud environments required.
  • Experience implementing or supporting platform observability, including logging, monitoring, and performance diagnostics required.
  • Exposure to supporting application or infrastructure modernization efforts, including migration from on-premises to cloud environments preferred.
  • Exposure to AI/ML platform services preferred.
  • Experience supporting or enabling micro services-based architectures and modern application deployment patterns, including asynchronous system to system integration using queuing and messaging platforms preferred.
  • Exposure to platform security and compliance controls preferred.
  • Exposure to developer platform or self-service enablement preferred.
  • Exposure to cost optimization or resource efficiency practices preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS offering preferred.
  • Strong background in creating secure cloud architectures and implementation for Internet-facing applications.
  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, influencing, collaboration and negotiation skills required.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator, Developer, or Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer within 1-1/2 Yrs preferred.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications, Azure AI Engineer Associate, AI Fundamentals within 1-1/2 Yrs preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to interact in a positive, respectful manner and establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.
  • Ability to display excellent customer service to meet the needs and expectations of both internal and external customers.
  • Excellent listening and interpersonal communication skills to identify critical core competencies based on success factors and organizational environment.

Mobility

Physical Requirements

Ability to travel within and around the facility or Work from Home (WFH) environment. Capable of using a telephone, computer keyboard, and mouse. Ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

jobs.title: Multimedia Producer
jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we want to help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLabAt CoLab, we want to help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We believe the fastest moving engineering teams in the world will soon automate all of the tedious aspects of design reviews—and CoLab is how they’ll do it. Our cloud-based platform enables collaborative, effective design conversations directly in the context of CAD.

Now, we’re building ReviewAI. By capturing expert knowledge and organizing feedback data, we’ve made it possible for AI to AutoReview drawings and 3D models. Now, engineers can spend less time on simple drawing checks and more time on tough technical problems.

About the RoleWe’re hiring a Multimedia Producer to bring CoLab's story to life through product animations and motion-driven video content.

You’ll bring video projects to life once the core concept is defined. That means collaborating on the storyboard (which may originate from product marketing, field marketing, demand gen, or content), reviewing and challenging the creative direction, and then owning the execution from finalized storyboard through to the finished product.

Your work will fall into 3 core categories:

  1. Product Marketing Animations: You’ll design and animate videos that show how CoLab works, with a focus on visual clarity and compelling storytelling. These are multi-step engineering workflows that don’t come across in static images or screen recordings. You’ll help bring them to life through UI simulation, motion design, and animations that focus the viewer’s attention exactly where it needs to be.
  2. Demand Generation & Social Video: These videos will have faster turnaround times and higher volume. You might be editing clips of the CEO giving a talk or a customer providing a testimonial—shorter video edits that highlight real voices and social proof. These can be 30–60 seconds in length and published multiple times per month.
  3. Bringing the CoLab Brand to Life: You’ll craft distinctive, highly polished brand centric videos that strengthen CoLab’s visual identity and tell our story with clarity and impact.

What Success Looks LikeBy the end of your first quarter, success means:

  • Publishing one thoughtful, animated product marketing video per month
  • Shipping at least three short-form, live-action or social-ready video clips
  • Building a deep knowledge of CoLab, how the platform works, the problems it solves, and the audiences it serves.

Longer term, the goal is to ramp up to:

  • Producing two product marketing animations per month, working toward one per week as processes mature
  • Sustaining a consistent cadence of short-form video content across campaigns and platforms

This mix of polished brand videos, high-velocity social clips, and in-depth product explainers will give CoLab a consistent video presence, tailored to each stage of the buyer journey.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You’re creatively driven, but deeply practical. You love the craft of motion design and want your work to make a real impact.
  • You have strong knowledge of brand design and are able to work creatively within strict brand guidelines and established design systems, so that every video feels like a “CoLab video” from the moment it starts.
  • You have high standards and treat feedback as a way to sharpen your work—not a personal critique. You’ll revise something 12 times if that’s what it takes to make it excellent.
  • You know how to show—not just tell—how a technical product works. You bring a technical curiosity that helps you translate complex concepts into clean, sharp visuals.
  • You’re equal parts animator, motion designer, and editor. You know how to stage product moments, simulate UI interactions, and add visual polish that elevates the viewer experience.
  • You understand audio and know how to balance music, voiceover, and sound design to set the tone and elevate the content.
  • You’re motivated by visibility. You want to see your work out in the world, shared by teams and seen by future customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Take finalized storyboards and scripts and turn them into polished, engaging video assets
  • Work with CMO, product marketing, and design to review, challenge, and refine storyboards
  • Design and animate product marketing videos that enhance clarity and showcase CoLab’s capabilities
  • Create high-volume, short-form demand-gen and social videos that drive visibility and engagement
  • Animate or enhance product workflows using motion design techniques to direct viewer focus and improve comprehension
  • Curate audio, voiceover, and visual assets to align with CoLab’s brand and tone
  • Manage projects from storyboard handoff through final delivery on a fast, iterative schedule with minimal oversight

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a motion design, animation, or multimedia production role, ideally in a B2B tech or SaaS environment
  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Suite, primarily After Effects and Premiere Pro, with working knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with tools like Figma, Blender and screen-recording software
  • A compelling motion design and video editing portfolio that demonstrates expertise in creating product explainers, UI animations, and highly polished brand-focused content.
  • Ability to translate technical workflows into digestible, visually compelling animated formats
  • Bonus: experience with 3D animation, Lottie, or engineering-related software

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.
  • Extended health and benefits package, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP matching.
  • Remote-friendly: you can work from anywhere in North America, with access to our HQ in St. John’s, NL.

Equity NoteFrequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter (Commercial & Corporate Hiring) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth.

You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.


What You’ll Do

Business Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends.

  • Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions.

  • Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.

  • Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience across multiple business and corporate functions.

  • Proven success recruiting for functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, Consulting, CEO Office, or other business-critical roles.

  • Demonstrated ability to hire senior, niche, and difficult-to-fill positions across multiple markets.

  • Strong expertise in sourcing passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, talent mapping, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence hiring decisions and challenge hiring assumptions when necessary.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, organizational design discussions, and workforce planning initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, project management, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, consulting firms, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality hires across multiple business functions and regions.

  • Builds sustainable talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill business roles.

  • Becomes a trusted advisor to business leaders and hiring managers.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Exposure to global hiring across multiple countries and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership on critical business hiring initiatives.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to building and scaling world-class teams.

jobs.description:
Standard Job Description

The Critical Skills Talent Pipeline Sourcer is a strategic talent intelligence function. You will be the architect of high-quality, future ready candidate pipelines across the organization's most critical and hard-to-fill skill areas. Working at the intersection of data, relationships, and market intelligence, you'll partner with Talent Acquisition leaders, recruiters, and hiring leaders to ensure we're never starting from zero when critical roles open.

This is a proactive, research-intensive role for someone who thrives on the hunt, someone who finds the candidates others can't, builds communities before there's a req, and turns market data into actionable hiring strategy.

What You Will Be Doing:

Pipeline Development & Sourcing Strategy
• Design and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies to build robust, ready-now and ready-next talent pipelines for critical and emerging skill areas across the organization.
• Identify, engage, and convert passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, GitHub, Boolean search, professional communities, industry events, and targeted referral campaigns.
• Build and manage segmented talent pools for high priority, niche, and hard-to-fill roles, ensuring pipelines are continuously refreshed and engagement is maintained.

Market Intelligence & Talent Research

• Conduct in-depth market mapping and competitive talent research to identify target companies, talent concentrations, compensation benchmarks, and candidate personas.
• Deliver ongoing insights to TA leadership and hiring managers on talent supply and demand, competitor hiring activity, and emerging skill trends.
• Translate market intelligence into sourcing recommendations that inform workforce planning and hiring timelines.

Stakeholder Partnership
• Partner closely with TA Leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to understand workforce plans, headcount forecasts, and evolving skill needs.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on talent availability and market conditions for assigned critical skill areas.
• Influence sourcing strategy and hiring expectations through data-backed storytelling and pipeline reporting.

Candidate Engagement & Experience
• Build and sustain authentic, long-term relationships with prospective candidates through personalized outreach, content sharing, and community engagement.
• Champion a positive candidate experience at every touchpoint, ensuring all pipeline members feel valued (whether or not there's an active opportunity).

Metrics & Operational Excellence

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline activity, candidate profiles, and engagement history within the ATS and CRM.
• Track and analyze sourcing KPIs including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time-to-engage, and source-of-hire effectiveness.

Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.Responsible for candidate sourcing and recruiting activities. Conducts interviews to recruit prospective employees and refers job applicants to specific job openings. Evaluates employment factors such as job experience, education and training, skills, knowledge and abilities, and other data pertinent to classification, selection, and referral. Works with all levels of management to understand job and needs requirements. Surfaces candidates and develops networks to ensure a strong pipeline of qualified candidates using agencies, recruiting contractors, web-based tools, and other resources. Prepares ratings on applicants, provides applicants with information on the company, arranges transportation of selected applicants, extends formal job offers, and works with management and HR to negotiate with candidates to successfully complete the hiring and on boarding process.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of experience in talent sourcing, recruiting, or talent acquisition, with demonstrated success building pipelines for technical or critical skill roles.
• Hands-on experience with sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, or comparable platforms.
• Strong Boolean search skills and ability to surface hard-to-find passive talent.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling, personalized outreach that converts.
• Proven ability to manage multiple pipelines, stakeholders, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desired Skills

• Experience supporting workforce planning or talent intelligence functions.
• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Beamery, Phenom, Avature) and ATS platforms (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS).
• Exposure to employer branding, talent marketing, or recruitment marketing campaigns.
• Experience in a corporate TA environment, RPO, or high-volume sourcing capacity.

Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Join Twin’s Contact Center, the team at the heart of our member experience, where every member who reaches out connects with a warm, knowledgeable representative focused on first-contact resolution. As a Member Service Representative, you are the first voice of Twin. You will support members wherever they are in their journey, from a first eligibility question through enrollment, device setup, scheduling, and everything in between, with the goal of resolving each need in a single interaction.

A successful candidate is a natural problem solver who owns each conversation from hello to resolution, treats every member with genuine care, and thrives in a dynamic environment where priorities shift based on member needs. A background in healthcare contact center support is preferred, but it is not required.

This is a temp to hire role that is full-time, remote and reports to the Member Service Lead. Representatives who demonstrate strong performance, meet key metrics, and pass technical competency evaluations during their initial 90-day assignment will be considered for permanent full-time conversion.

The schedule for this position is Tuesday - Saturday, 9:30am–6:00pm EST.

Responsibilities

  • Premier Call Center Support & White-Glove Service
    • Serve as the first point of contact for current and prospective members, responding to incoming calls with warmth, professionalism, and genuine care in every interaction.
    • Own each interaction end to end, resolving the member’s need in a single touchpoint whenever possible.
    • Proactively identify opportunities to exceed expectations and create memorable service moments that reinforce member loyalty
  • Enrollment, Eligibility, and Scheduling
    • Answer eligibility and benefit questions and verify member eligibility.
    • Guide prospective members through enrollment calls to completion, including app download and invite code support.
    • Schedule and reschedule any Care Team visit, sensor activation visit, and lab appointments.
  • Device and Order Troubleshooting
    • Walk members through the initial device setup.
    • Troubleshoot device issues, including sensor syncing, replacements, and supply replenishment.
    • Identify and resolve kit ordering issues.
  • Operational Excellence and Growth
    • Accurately record all interactions and outcomes in our systems, including Salesforce, Zendesk, and Talkdesk.
    • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all regulatory standards.
    • Complete assigned work-queue tasks and follow-ups between calls, flexing across channels as member demand shifts throughout the day.
    • Participate in daily huddles, ongoing training, and quality coaching, and apply feedback quickly.
    • Additional duties as assigned to support the team's mission of ensuring member health, satisfaction, and retention
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in a healthcare contact center or similar member facing healthcare support role is strongly preferred, especially experience helping people navigate enrollment, benefits, or care over the phone.
  • A warm, clear, and confident phone presence with strong active listening skills.
  • Genuine empathy and patience, especially with members navigating health challenges or new technology.
  • Comfort in learning and working across multiple technical platforms at once. Experience with Salesforce, Zendesk, or Talkdesk is a plus.
  • Coachability. You welcome feedback, apply it quickly, and are motivated by clear performance goals and competency milestones.
  • Dependability, with consistent attendance and schedule adherence in a structured contact center environment.
  • A quiet, professional remote workspace with access to high speed internet and reliable phone service.
  • Ability to work full time within Contact Center operating hours (Monday through Saturday, 9:00am to 8:00pm EST).
  • Bilingual (Spanish speaking) strongly preferred.
  • Passion for Twin’s purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent and improve chronic metabolic diseases.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Potential for Permanent Status

This is a full-time temporary position starting at $21.00 per hour. High-performing representatives who pass our technical competency evaluations during their initial 90-day assignment will have the opportunity to be evaluated for permanent full-time conversion.

Benefits

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors.
