Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.

Job Summary:

The Project Development Associate I will deliver fully developed and planned projects in preparation for customer contract execution. This role works closely with Senior Associates and the commercial team to document customer needs and Highland commitments, helping to advance deals by acting as a junior site development resource. The Associate I will collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Market Development to help ensure projects meet underwriting requirements, and will assist in managing external engineers and consultants to finalize site designs for handoff to the Customer Success and Project Execution teams.

Over time, the selected candidate will grow into a more autonomous role, taking on these project development responsibilities with increasing independence.

This position reports to the Manager, Project Development and is based remotely in California, with an expectation of approximately 20% travel.

Responsibilities:

  • Support Senior Associates and Managers in establishing fleet electrification scopes of work for
    projects in development, including project timelines, budgets, and equipment selection.
  • Work with engineering teams to develop designs for complex EV charging depot projects,
    including solar and battery storage components.
  • Contribute to estimating engineering, construction, and interconnection costs for use in project
    budgets.
  • Coordinate the project site diligence process, including identifying real estate, zoning,
    permitting, and other development restrictions.
  • Help define project permitting requirements and support the preparation of related project
    engineering deliverables.
  • Assist in identifying utility requirements, filing new service requests, and communicating with
    utility representatives to define utility-related timelines and budgets.
  • Assist in managing projects through the design and engineering phases, including tracking
    schedules, budgets, and subcontractor deliverables.
  • Support the handoff to the project implementation team upon customer contract execution.
  • Contribute to work scoping methodology and documentation improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

    Required

  • Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of directly related professional experience.

    • Preferred

  • Experience working with electric utilities (e.g., interconnection, new service requests).
  • Exposure to electric vehicle charging, renewable energy, or related clean energy technologies.
  • Experience in electrical engineering, construction, or infrastructure project development.
  • Experience working with permitting authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs) or similar regulatorybodies.
  • Project management experience in engineering and/or construction environments.

What You Can Expect from Highland:

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
  • A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
  • Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) program and company match

jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is hiring a Director, Marketing Technology & Innovation, the most senior technology leader within our Marketing, Creative and Communications organization. To start, you will lead a hybrid team of Technical Program Managers (TPMs), AI Solutions Engineers, and third party platform engineering partners.

This role starts as a player-coach. You will be hands-on alongside your teams, finding resourceful solutions as the function takes shape, with the autonomy to make a few strategic hires as it grows. The right person is a genuine leader and developer of people who has not lost touch with the technology itself, still knows how to build and close enough to the stack to make smart decisions and earn the trust of both marketers and engineers.

What you'll do:

Lead AI Solutions & Platform and Tools

  • Own the AI roadmap and intake process for Marketing, Creative and Communications; drive production-grade AI solution development across org-wide infrastructure, team-level products, and individual workflows, with every initiative shipping with a full adoption plan
  • Lead the Platform & Tools team, which owns and evolves the marketing sites platform and the full Marketing, Creative and Communications tools ecosystem; the team has established intake, governance, vendor operations, and cross-functional processes across Engineering, Legal, IT, and Security, and your role is to lead them forward
  • Set the operating model, culture, and prioritization framework across your teams, managing full-time technical talent alongside offshore agency engineering partnerships.

Own & Evolve the MarTech Stack

  • Own the end-to-end strategy, technical selection, and system integration of a broad marketing tech ecosystem (CRM, MAP, CDP, DAM, social management, and campaign tooling). Focus on system connectivity, API orchestration, and platform uptime, activating data pipelines managed by Data Science teams.
  • Oversee event-tracking and media enablement infrastructure (including server-side tagging/GTM, CAPI, and conversion pixels), navigating shared codebases with Product, Security, and Engineering.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the stack to ensure it reflects the future of marketing technology: integrated, scalable, and built to support the organization as it grows
  • Manage the full vendor lifecycle: contract negotiations, renewals, license optimization, and performance management, with a clear view of total cost of ownership across the ecosystem
  • Own the marketing technology budget and investment strategy, applying a disciplined build vs. buy vs. expand framework to every decision; know when to invest in something new, when to consolidate, and when to get more out of what already exists
  • Partner with Legal and Security on data privacy, compliance, and tool governance to ensure the stack meets regulatory requirements across all markets

Embed AI Across the Marketing Stack

  • Implement AI natively within the MarTech stack, not as standalone tools, but woven into CRM workflows, lifecycle automation, campaign optimization, and audience segmentation so AI accelerates every layer of the stack
  • Tackle and execute projects such as building agentic AI workforces that automate project management functions: intelligent intake routing, automated brief generation, workflow orchestration, cross-functional task coordination, and real-time status tracking, replacing manual overhead with systems that run themselves
  • Build production-grade AI solutions across the marketing organization; every solution ships with an owner, launch date, and adoption plan, partnering with the Director of Strategic Enablement to ensure full adoption and people development across the tech stack; maintain a centralized AI asset repository to prevent duplicated spend

Operate as an Executive Thought Leader

  • Influence across the Marketing, Creative and Communications leadership team, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and IT; represent Pinterest's MarTech vision externally with vendors, agency partners, and technology platforms
  • Serve as the connective tissue between the organization's marketing ambitions and Pinterest's broader technical infrastructure, translating business goals into architecture decisions and vice versa

What we're looking for:

Hands-on marketing experience and hands-on AI implementation experience are both required for this role, not differentiators.

  • Seniority and scope: minimum of 10 years of technical leadership experience (with Director-level scope) building, configuring, and integrating enterprise MarTech systems (CRM, MAP, CDP, DAM) in environments where you defined the stack.
  • Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Technical & Platform Command: Solid background in API integrations, web platform architecture, server-side tracking, CMS ecosystems, and modern delivery practices (CI/CD, agile execution).
  • Hands-on marketing expertise: worked directly in or alongside marketing organizations; a genuine partner to marketers across brand, performance, lifecycle, and communications, not a technology vendor to them
  • Hands-on AI implementation: integrated AI and LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) directly into marketing stacks, including CRM automation, lifecycle triggers, predictive segmentation, and campaign optimization; AI tooling alongside the stack does not qualify
  • Agentic AI systems: designed and deployed multi-agent AI workforces that automate operational processes: intake routing, brief generation, workflow orchestration, and cross-functional coordination
  • Data Science Partnership: Strong experience collaborating with Data Science/Engineering teams, understanding how to integrate and activate their data models within marketing execution platforms.
  • Player-coach: coaches and develops people, still builds when needed, and embeds a culture of learning across the organization, not just for individuals
  • Industry thought leadership: brings a recognized external perspective on MarTech and AI; contributes to how the industry thinks, stays ahead of trends, and applies that lens internally
  • Technical command: strong grasp of web platform architecture, API integrations, CMS ecosystems, and modern delivery practices (CI/CD, agile, sprint-based execution)
  • Full-stack MarTech fluency: CRM, CDP, MAP, DAM, social management, and the integration layer
  • Executive communication: distills technical complexity for a non-technical C-suite, runs rigorous vendor evaluations, and earns the confidence of both engineers and marketers

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

jobs.title: GIS Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Ting Internet is a leading fiber Internet provider in the United States, delivering future-proof internet in over a dozen Ting Towns across the country.
jobs.description:
Ting Internet is a leading fiber Internet provider in the United States, delivering future-proof internet in over a dozen Ting Towns across the country.

As part of Tucows (NASDAQ:TCX, TSX:TC), Ting is backed by outstanding resources and talent. We embrace a people-first philosophy that is rooted in respect, trust, and flexibility. We believe that whatever works for our employees is what works best for us.

The work we do genuinely changes lives. If this sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you!

Position Overview

As a fixed-line Fiber provider, Ting relies on knowing where our customers are and where our fiber is so we can bring those two things together. GIS (Geographic Information Systems) is all about modelling real-world objects as data that other digital systems can work with. Your job as a GIS Specialist is to ensure the data in these systems does match the real world, and then use this data to answer business questions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the GIS ticket queue to support our internal users
    • Solve suspected data issues such as address availability check errors by looking at plant drawings, maps, aerial and street photographs, and other sources of data to determine if our system might have the wrong data. Correct as necessary, or confirm an unexpected case is in fact accurate.
    • Add newly created addresses. If a building adds an apartment, or a new building is constructed on an empty lot, the new address needs to be added to our system.
  • Audit partner address releases
    • Our partner providers invoice us for passed addresses, serviced addresses, and other incremental services that need to be checked against what they have actually provided to us. Using reports, tracking sheets, and automation tools that you will help to design, ensure that our numbers match their numbers.
    • Receive address delivery batches from partners when new areas are constructed. This data must be checked and ingested into our database so customers can place orders. We also need to track releases so we can account for the pro-rated invoice the following month. Partner deliveries also need to be checked against map data to ensure they didn’t deliver addresses that don’t exist, or deliver the same one twice.
  • As-Built and Records Maintenance
    • Ingest as-built records from partner and organic construction into our systems of record. Convert from various CAD formats to structured data formats that can be ingested by IQGeo and other systems.
    • Maintain the data sets in IQGeo and other systems in response to network changes, additional plant placements, and otherwise ensure that our system of record always reflects the actual state of our plant, and the plant of our partner networks.
  • Periodic Tasks:
    • Work with the design team to correctly update IQGeo with plant moves or other changes to the physical network that need to be reflected back here.
    • Twice a year, produce output to support our FCC reporting. This process is very automatable, but it still requires human judgment to define how the process should work and to ensure our filings happen accurately. On a different twice-annual basis, download the aggregated FCC data that becomes publicly available and ingest it back into our database so we can use it for business intelligence.
    • Use database queries and other geospatial tools to generate reports for internal stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Geography was actually fun for you. Maybe you enjoy looking at maps and exploring real places without leaving your desk.
  • Attention to detail! This is the most important skill, as the accuracy of our data affects every downstream process.
  • Familiarity with IQGeo. This is the main tool used by the GIS team for viewing plant data and the addresses we manage (organic, partners with no system of their own). This is a fairly intuitive web-based tool, but has some nuances to it.
  • Experience with SQL queries, especially PostGIS. Our underlying database is PostGIS. Being able to construct an SQL query to produce aggregate data or work with batches can save a great deal of manual work.
  • Experience with other GIS tools such as ArcGIS Pro. This is another ancillary tool used to store map layers and do other data aggregations. Not strictly necessary, but a nice-to-have.
  • You like to help others, but not necessarily be on the front-lines of customer service. You will be supporting Ting people internally only.
  • You are a good self-starter and can work independently. The work is largely asynchronous, but we need to provide a high service level to our internal customers and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • You have the tenacity to get work done, but are just lazy enough to look at repetitive tasks and think about how better tools could take the grunt work out of it.

Qualifications

  • Completed Post-secondary education in Applied Geography, Geographic Information Systems or equivalent experience
  • Industry and GIS/CAD specific certifications and training preferred
  • 3+ years of GIS/AutoCAD/Network documentation system experience
  • 2+ years of demonstrated experience with spatial data, data entry and conversion
  • 2+ years demonstrated outstanding project management skills
  • Programming experience with Go, Python, and PostGIS an asset

The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000 USD for US residents OR $72,000 - $82,000 CAD for Canadian residents. Other countries will differ. Range may vary on a number of factors including, but not limited to: location, experience and qualifications. Tucows believes in a total rewards offering that includes fair compensation and generous benefits. Learn more about Tucows Benefits.

Tucows and its subsidiaries participate in the E-verify program for all US employees.

Want to know more about what we stand for? At Ting and Tucows we care about protecting the open Internet, narrowing digital divide, and supporting fairness and equality.

We also know that diversity drives innovation. We are committed to inclusion across race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. We celebrate multiple approaches and diverse points of view.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

We use AI-enabled tools throughout our recruitment process to help us work more efficiently and consistently. These tools support our hiring teams by organizing and reviewing information, while final hiring decisions are always made by people.

Job Title: Data Analytics Lead

Job Location: Toronto, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Ostro sits at the intersection of life sciences, marketing, and artificial intelligence. We empower pharmaceutical brands, healthcare providers (HCPs), and patients by orchestrating AI-enabled omnichannel engagement across the entire patient and prescriber lifecycle.
As the Data Analytics Lead, you will own the data systems and associated measurement analyses that sit at the intersection of our products, customers, and commercial strategy. Our products generate significant data as users ask questions and take action, and you will work with the product team to surface and execute on insights that govern how our product evolves. This data is also used by our customers in their planning efforts, and you will work closely with our client service and implementation teams to enable and deliver on customized analyses that reflect the nuances of each client’s strategy. To deliver on the above, you will proactively architect, build, and scale the next generation of our data platform to make it modern, scalable, and AI-ready.

What You'll Do

    • Modern Data Architecture & Engineering: Work alongside platform and data engineers to upgrade our existing data architecture to be high fidelity, AI-ready, and easily accessible for both internal and external users
    • Customer Data Integrations: Guide the execution of data integrations into select customer systems in partnership with our solutions engineering team
    • Product Analyses: Uplevel our standard suite of analytics and measurement insights in partnership with our product team
    • Custom Analyses: Execute on client-specific, custom analytical requests in partnership with our client services team
    • Leadership & Team Mentorship: Direct and grow a team of data analysts and data engineers

Requirements

    • Deep, hands-on expertise in SQL / Python and strong capabilities in data modeling, advanced quantitative analysis, and working with large data sets
    • Strong command of modern data architecture particularly in enabling AI readiness. You will not be the sole engineer building every component yourself, but you need enough technical depth to actively participate in the design and build
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in data science/analytics and/or data engineering roles including in a managerial capacity leading teams
    • Recent work experience should relate to the pharmaceutical / life sciences industry (not necessarily at a pharmaceutical / life sciences company)
    • Undergrad or masters in a technical discipline (computer science, statistics, engineering, math, physics, etc.)

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • PTO and company-paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $150,000 - $250,000 CAD
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Corporate Recruiter, you will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to support the organization’s workforce needs. Reporting to the Talent Acquisition Sr. Manager, you will manage an average requisition load of 16–20 open positions at a time, supporting a diverse range of roles from manufacturing and operations leadership to engineering and other professional positions.

You will partner closely with hiring leaders to develop effective recruiting strategies and deliver a strong candidate experience. The ideal candidate is a proactive, relationship-driven recruiter who can effectively manage competing priorities, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about connecting great talent with the right opportunities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage an average portfolio of 16–20 requisitions, balancing priorities and ensuring consistent progress across assigned openings.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define hiring requirements, and develop effective recruiting strategies.
  • Recruit across a diverse portfolio of positions, including manufacturing leadership, operations, engineering, and other professional roles.
  • Source and attract qualified candidates through job boards, social media, networking, referrals, direct outreach, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Review applications and resumes to identify qualified candidates and maintain strong talent pipelines.
  • Conduct recruiter screens and interviews to assess candidates’ experience, skills, and alignment with the role and organization.
  • Coordinate interviews and maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
  • Partner with hiring managers to facilitate efficient and effective interview and selection processes.
  • Conduct reference checks and coordinate background screening and other pre-employment requirements.
  • Extend offers, communicate compensation and employment details, and support candidates through the offer and acceptance process.
  • Proactively build and maintain talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
  • Track recruiting activity and maintain accurate and timely candidate and requisition information within the applicant tracking system.
  • Stay current on recruiting trends, labor market conditions, sourcing strategies, and talent acquisition best practices.
  • Contribute to Talent Acquisition initiatives, process improvements, and other HR projects as needed.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within a corporate or manufacturing environment.
  • Proven success recruiting for salaried professional positions, including manufacturing leadership, operations, engineering, and other specialized roles.
  • Strong understanding of labor market trends and the ability to translate market insights into effective recruiting strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume requisition portfolio, typically supporting 16–20 open requisitions while effectively prioritizing competing demands.
  • Ability to act as a change agent and champion process excellence, driving continuous improvement across Talent Acquisition.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly to changing business priorities.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple searches and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy, follow-through, and operational efficiency.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and other recruiting or HR technology.
  • Working knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and recruiting compliance requirements.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-oriented approach to recruiting challenges.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive candidate and employee information.

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. Job Description

Do you pride yourself on your ability to lead and motivate a team?

Are you passionate about helping people to lead healthier lives?

Then consider the role of Health & Wellbeing Coach Manager at Reed Wellbeing!

The role is remote, however will require regular travel to and around Kensington, Chelsea, and Westminster, therefore you will need to live within London.

Internal applications for this role close on 27/08/2026.

Who we are

Reed Wellbeing is a public services provider that aims to support people in making sustainable lifestyle changes to improve their physical and mental wellbeing. Since 2015, we have been delivering a range of evidence-based, person centred interventions and services, including: NHS Health Checks, Smoking Cessation, Weight Management and Type 2 Diabetes Prevention and Treatment.

Our One You Kensington, Chelsea, and Westminster service helps its local residents live healthier lives and reduce their chances of developing serious illnesses. Our support includes guidance on moving more, being tobacco free, eating well, drinking less, and losing weight.

What is the role about?

As a Health & Wellbeing Coach Manager, you’ll play a key role in delivering and managing community-based lifestyle and wellbeing services. This role is multi-disciplinary and involves leading one or more specialist service streams (such as weight management or smoking cessation), line managing a small team of Health & Wellbeing Coaches and directly delivering behavioural change interventions. The volume of each responsibility will vary according to business needs.

Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Taking Ownership

  • Line managing a small team of Health & Wellbeing coaches to deliver high quality lifestyle and wellbeing services.
  • Conducting team meetings, performance reviews, and development planning.
  • Monitoring performance, trends and best practice to identify areas of improvement for designated service

Working Together

  • Liaising with other internal stakeholders such as the Programme Support team and Health & Wellbeing Managers to ensure efficient coordination of team resources.
  • Meeting with stakeholders and attending local events to build and strengthen referral pathways.

Being Fair, Open and Honest

  • Delivering engaging 1:2:1 or group-based health and wellbeing interventions to a caseload of participants either in a face-to-face, remote, or digital setting.

What’s in it for you?:

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus much more that can be foundon our website

The Health & Wellbeing Coach Manager role allows you to make a real difference in people’s lives by helping them improve their health and wellbeing. With a dynamic and varied workload, this is a highly rewarding role for someone with strong leadership and people skills. At Reed in Partnership, our values - Fair, Open & Honest, Take Ownership, and Work Together, guide everything we do. Join us in delivering services that make a real difference.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • At least 12 months of recent experience of managing teams within a customer focused, target orientated environment.
  • Experience of promoting/marketing public services to stakeholder / referral partners.
  • Demonstrative experience of developing productive external stakeholder relationships.
  • High level of personal organisation and time management skills.
  • Experience of delivering services within a quality assurance and governance framework.
  • Ability to establish an effective and appropriate rapport with programme participants who need to achieve and maintain lifestyle changes (e.g. healthy weight, increased physical activity, reduction in alcohol intake).
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel in order to deliver programmes across designated region, as well as living within London.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Knowledge and understanding of the service stream(s) they will lead on e.g. diabetes prevention, weight management, smoking cessation, physical inactivity etc.
  • Degree or equivalent qualification in a health-related subject (e.g. health improvement, promotion, public health, nutrition etc); and/or
  • A professional qualification & registration relevant to the service stream. For example for Adult Weight Management, this would be: a Degree in dietetics; or a Postgraduate Diploma or Masters in dietetics); and Registration with BDA or equivalent.
  • Experience of delivering group-based services/programmes.
  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include: Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (dependent on location of service delivery).

Working at Abbott

This position works remotely supporting our customer service teams in the Cancer Diagnostics division.

Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key health and therapeutic areas, including infectious disease, cardiometabolic, informatics, and toxicology.  

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. Our molecular division delivers best-in-class innovative testing solutions for people around the world to provide answers to life’s critical health decisions.  We help people live full and healthy lives through our accessible, molecular-based solutions. 

Position Overview

The Senior Workforce Analyst plays a key role in informing enterprise workforce and operational decisions through advanced analytics, strategic workforce planning, and performance management. This position leads complex forecasting, KPI development, and performance scorecards that support significant workforce investments, operating budgets, and service delivery decisions across multiple business units. By integrating workforce demand forecasting, employee performance analytics, and contact center operational metrics, the Senior Analyst ensures the organization maintains the right talent, in the right roles, at the right time. The role works closely with senior leadership, HR, Operations, Finance, and Workforce Management teams to provide data-driven insights that guide strategic planning, optimize workforce spending, and improve operational performance with multimillions investments.

About Native

Native is defining a new category in Cloud Security by empowering organizations to build truly secure-by-design environments. As Native's founding Head of Channel, you'll design, launch, and scale our U.S. channel program from the ground up. This is a builder’s role. You’ll take full ownership of the program from day one - writing partner agreements, standing up the portal, training the first sales engineers at our partners, and personally supporting early deals through registration and closing. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives, marketing, product, and leadership to turn channel into a durable, multi-million-dollar revenue engine.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in channel, partnerships, or alliances roles in B2B cybersecurity or cloud security, with a strong preference for time spent in early-stage and high-growth startups.
  • Demonstrated experience building a channel program from zero - not just running an existing one. You've authored partner agreements, defined tiers and economics, stood up deal reg and PRM systems, and shipped enablement content yourself.
  • Track record of driving meaningful partner-sourced and partner-influenced ARR, ideally helping take a company from initial channel traction to $10M+ in partner-attributed revenue.
  • Established relationships across the U.S. cybersecurity partner ecosystem: national and regional VARs (e.g., Optiv, GuidePoint, Trace3, Set Solutions, Defy Security), cloud-focused GSIs, and key distributors.
  • Comfort operating as a player-coach / individual contributor - happy to recruit a partner on Monday, run an enablement session on Tuesday, and ride along on a customer call with that partner on Wednesday.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you can model partner economics, structure margin and incentive programs that actually motivate behavior, and avoid channel conflict with direct sellers.
  • Ability to translate technical product value into a partner-ready story - pitch decks, battlecards, demo paths, and certification tracks that partners will actually use.
  • Excellent communicator and cross-functional operator; comfortable working closely with AEs, marketing, product, and finance to align on partner strategy and execution.
  • You actively leverage AI and modern sales tools not just to scale existing workflows, but to rethink how channel is built - experimenting rapidly, unlocking new approaches, and continuously evolving strategy and execution.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful early-stage equity.
  • A rare opportunity to be the founding channel hire at a fast-growing cybersecurity startup and to architect the partner program from a blank page.
  • Direct influence on GTM strategy, partner economics, marketing investment, and how Native scales beyond direct sales.
  • Close collaboration with experienced founders, security experts, and operators who view channel as a core pillar of the business — not an afterthought.
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and the chance to build something from the ground up

Why Join Now?

This isn’t just channel - it’s the opportunity to build and scale a partner program from the ground up, and shape how Native grows beyond direct sales.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Partner Manager owns and grows Power Digital’s relationships with executives, SMB consulting firms, and agencies across the East Coast, activating our referral partner playbook to consistently source new pipeline and revenue.

In this role, you will onboard and activate partners in your book, build the kind of trust that makes Power Digital a partner’s first call, and turn that trust into partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue. You’ll work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, client service, and product to keep partners enabled and referrals flowing, and you’ll report directly to the VP of Partnerships.

Responsibilities:

Relationship Management & Partner Enablement

  • Manage a portfolio of executive partners (founders/ fractional CMOs/ Industry leaders) as their primary day-to-day point of contact, meeting with them regularly to build trust, understand their goals, and identify ways to accelerate shared revenue.
  • Run Power Digital’s referral partner playbook with each partner — equipping them with the positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation to confidently refer business — and proactively monitor partner sentiment and engagement to protect the relationship and referral flow.

Pipeline & Revenue

  • Support partners in pipeline generation and deal execution, owning partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue targets.
  • Work closely with sales to keep rules of engagement clean and ensure a smooth handoff on partner-sourced and influenced opportunities.
  • Report on referral partner pipeline, conversion, and performance metrics on a regular cadence, flagging risks and opportunities to the VP of Partnerships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Co-Marketing

  • Partner with partner marketing on thought leadership and field events that enable partners.
  • Collaborate with client service to understand the sentiment and performance of referred clients, and close the loop with partners on outcomes.
  • Serve as the voice of the partner internally, surfacing feedback and market intelligence to product, sales, and marketing.

Role Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing, sales, or partnerships at an agency or tech company.
  • Experience managing a pipeline or shared pipeline in partnership with a sales team.
  • Experience working with professional services firms, consulting firms, agencies, and/or fractional CMOs/executives.
  • Strong project management skills, with a proven ability to run multiple partner engagements in parallel, across different stages, without dropping balls.
  • Experience with slack, claude, salesforce (preferred)
  • Based on the East Coast (NYC preferred), with the ability to travel up to 25%.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline
  • Partner-Sourced Revenue
  • Partner-Influenced Revenue

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Partner Activation: Onboard and activate every partner in your book against the referral partner playbook.
  • Pipeline & Revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue targets, converting relationships into a consistent, trackable flow of referrals.
  • Relationship Depth: Build enough trust with execs, consulting firms, and agencies in your market that Power Digital is the first call when a client need comes up.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.excerpt: Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.
jobs.description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

Reporting to the Field Director, Medical Sciences, the Senior (Sr.) Medical Scientist / Associate Director Medical Scientist (we will consider candidates with strong experience at either level), is a scientific professional who serves as a key field-based scientific resource for healthcare providers, patients, investigators, and internal colleagues. This role will come with high visibility in our company with critical cross-functional relationships across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development / Operations, and Commercial. This role will focus on key opinion leaders and other HCPs in the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and heart failure therapeutic areas while supporting pipeline products in development.

Our passion is anchored in rigorous and diligent scientific and clinical approaches to the discovery and development of novel mechanism therapeutics. With gratitude for the commitments and convictions of our employees who are inspired by the courage of patients we aim to serve, we believe Cytokinetics will continue to be a pioneering, values-driven, sustainable, fully integrated biopharmaceutical company.

Major Cities / Areas Covered

  • Southeastern PA

  • Philadelphia

  • New Jersey

Responsibilities

  • Through development of a territory strategic plan, identify national, regional, and local Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) involved with the provision of cardiovascular care within institutional care centers and engage them in proactive and reactive scientific exchange

  • Maintain and broaden professional relationships with HCPs (physicians, NPs, PAs, nurses, and pharmacists) in institutional care centers to expand research, advisory, and educational partnership opportunities; identify areas of unmet medical need; and assure thoughtful exchange of current medical information related to products in development and therapeutic areas of importance

  • Contributes to planning and execution of Congress activities. This includes review of scientific programming of relevant conferences, attending sessions, supporting exhibit booth operations, and contributing to a timely written conference report summarizing key information, activities, and competitive intelligence to colleagues

  • Serve as a scientific expert at key medical and scientific conferences, advisory boards, clinical investigator meetings, internal meetings, and patient advocacy group meetings

  • Maintain a high-level of scientific knowledge and understanding about disease state, underlying science, treatment guidelines, available treatment agents and options, as well as heart failure and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy therapies under development.

  • Maintain a superior understanding of current trends in clinical research, competitive developments, patient care, and their impact on Cytokinetics’ medical strategies

  • Work with Medical Affairs and other internal colleagues on initiatives including medical information, publications, medical education, grants, speaker training, and other educational programs

  • Provide support to our clinical development programs by serving as a key point of contact for company-sponsored trial investigators, investigator-initiated research, and registries consistent with company objectives and regulations

  • Work compliantly and collaboratively with field account specialists in support of MYQORZO

  • Timely and accurately respond to unsolicited requests for Medical Information

In addition to the above, the Associate Director, Medical Scientist will:

  • Mentor and support Sr. Medical Scientist

  • Provide strategic input and execute region-specific plans to achieve KOL engagement goals and Medical Affairs departmental goals

  • Pursues projects independently with a high degree of quality and timely execution

  • Maintains a complete awareness of and understanding about current “real world” clinical practices, HEOR drivers, and emerging trends in treatments/medicine

  • Establish relationships with key executive leadership colleagues across Cytokinetics and connect external parties with appropriate leadership team members

Qualifications

  • Bilingual (Spanish) highly preferred.

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, or MD/DO, MS, PA, ARNP) preferred

  • For Sr. MSL, demonstration of 0-5 years of clinical or pharmaceutical industry experience.

  • For Associate Director, a minimum of 5 years of CV MSL experience is required. CV experience in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and/or heart failure is preferable.

  • Must be analytical and articulate in both oral and written communications, possess excellent presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate well with external stakeholders and all internal levels of the organization

  • Must understand Medical Science Liaison roles and responsibilities including compliance within the PhRMA Code Standards for Interactions with U.S. Healthcare Providers, Federal and State promotional laws and regulations, ACCME Standards, the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and all other company policies, rules and regulations

  • Comply with all credentialing requirements for any healthcare institution which is part of the Medical Science call plan, including, among other things, routine background checks, medical testing or proof of immunizations, training on facility policies, and adherence to confidentiality and/or HIPPA agreements

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and web-based applications

  • A valid US Driver’s License is required and maintain an acceptable driving record

  • Ability to travel both domestically (~30%-50%) and internationally on occasion (TBD)

  • Leveling of title will be commensurate with experience

Pay Range:

The expected salary range for this position is $197,460.00 - $247,800.00. The base pay offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Base salary is just one component of our competitive total compensation package, which includes equity in the form of stock options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at Cytokinetics and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you.

Please review our General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) policy PRIOR to applying.

jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for an Administrative Operations Assistant to support our Vice President, Oklo Isotopes and team as it builds a vertically integrated, domestic supply of critical radioisotopes.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Administrative Operations Assistant to support our Vice President, Oklo Isotopes and team as it builds a vertically integrated, domestic supply of critical radioisotopes.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking an experienced, dynamic, technically capable Administrative Operations Assistant to support the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, and the broader radioisotope production and vertical-integration effort. This role demands a combination of administrative prowess and the agility to navigate a fast-moving company at the frontier of advanced fission (nuclear energy) and the domestic production of critical radioisotopes for healthcare, industry, research, and national security.

Discretion is essential to this role. The Administrative Operations Assistant will regularly handle highly technical, sensitive, and confidential information across the Isotopes vertical, including proprietary technical data, regulatory and licensing materials, partner and vendor agreements, personnel matters, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and information subject to U.S. export-control laws. The role may also require access to regulated facilities operating under government oversight. Given the significance and scope of this work, the successful candidate must demonstrate sound judgment and treat confidentiality, compliance, and accountability as fundamental responsibilities of the position. Employment will be contingent upon the candidate’s ability to satisfy all applicable export-control, CUI-handling, background-screening, and facility-access requirements.

In your cover letter, please describe and link to any creative work you are particularly proud of — an event you planned, artwork, an article or blog post, a website you designed, or even a social media account.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Provide comprehensive support to the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, including calendar management, coordinating meetings, and handling travel arrangements
  • Efficiently process and distill a high volume of incoming information, presenting it in a prioritized manner to the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, and facilitating subsequent actions
  • Prepare and edit presentations, reports, and other critical documents, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery
  • Manage confidential information with discretion, upholding the company’s data protection standards
  • Proactively address and resolve administrative and technical challenges
  • Assist with project coordination, ensuring milestones are met and updates are communicated effectively
  • Handle ad-hoc tasks and projects as required, showcasing resourcefulness and adaptability
  • Schedule events with key stakeholders efficiently and smoothly

During the initial phase of this role, the successful candidate may provide temporary on-site logistics and administrative support while the company recruits a dedicated full-time facilities professional. Responsibilities may include coordinating the setup of temporary office trailers, arranging regular deliveries of water, beverages, and snacks, establishing janitorial services, and supporting events and hospitality for site visitors. This interim support will help ensure smooth and professional site operations until the facilities position is filled.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5-8 years proven experience as an assistant or in a similar role, with a preference for those familiar with technical environments
  • Serve as a calendar strategist, prioritizing and sequencing meetings to advance key objectives—not simply scheduling appointments
  • Strong technical proficiency with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools and software, including Google Suite, Slack, Box, Atlassian, Asana, Microsoft Office Suite, and Adobe Acrobat to make tracked changes, add redlining/comments to documents, and create PDFs
  • Familiarity with AI tools is a plus — and/or a willingness to learn new tools to work more efficiently
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize tasks
  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs and challenges
  • U.S. citizenship is required for the compliance reasons outlined above
  • Remote; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred, but not required

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of the nuclear power industry and isotopes is a plus but not required

Competencies

We are looking for an Administrative Operations Assistant who is:

  • Handles confidential and technical information with the utmost discretion, sharing it only with authorized individuals and through approved systems
  • Understands and respects access boundaries, approvals, data-protection standards, and export-control requirements, and escalates promptly when something is unclear
  • Provides steady, reliable support the department can depend on — closing loops, following through, and safeguarding the accuracy and security of information at every step
  • Exercises sound judgment about what may be discussed, with whom, and in what setting, protecting the confidentiality of the department, its partners, and the company
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $70,000-$90,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

An LX designer will review your content and send comments back; you'll iterate from there. Your audience: experienced engineers looking to level up to system architecture roles. They will spot shallow content instantly.

Areas of expertise

SME A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)

  • Review and shape the existing syllabus draft — validate topic sequencing, flag gaps or unrealistic scope, and make sure the content reflects how these systems are actually built in production.

  • Produce lessons using AI-gen tools following our content guidelines — then review, fact-check, and fine-tune the output until it's technically sound.
  • Design hands-on projects and exercises that are realistic for a working engineer studying 20 hrs/week.

  • Respond to LX designer feedback and iterate on content — this is a back-and-forth process, not a one-time handoff.

  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company — not just coursework or side projects
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented
  • Strong technical communication skills — ability to explain complex topics clearly to learners
  • Comfortable using AI tools for content drafting and iteration
  • Strong English C1+ — content will be in English for a US-based audience
  • Attention to detail, proactivity and ability to meet deadlines independently

As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development.

As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris.

What success looks like

  • Participate in and lead the entire biosignal-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation.
  • Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective.
  • Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation.
  • Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user-friendly, well-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non-regression testing.
  • Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement.
  • Support the client-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development.

What you will bring

  • You have more than 4 years of industry experience in machine learning and deep learning, particularly in health sciences or other regulated fields, with a proven track record of bringing algorithms into production.

  • You are familiar with biosignals, medical imaging data, or large time-series datasets, or are enthusiastic about learning more in the domain.

  • You are able to distill, discuss, and present complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for the audience at hand, both internally and externally.
  • You are excited to participate in the entire algorithm development lifecycle, which spans scoping, data wrangling, algorithm development/experimentation, formal validation, quality/regulatory documentation, production deployment, and working with clients who might benefit from these algorithms.

The Role at a Glance

About Daon

Daon is a global leader in the defence against digital identity fraud and AI-generated synthetic identities. For over a quarter of a century, we have partnered with governments and leading enterprises to deliver secure, seamless identity experiences across financial services, telecommunications, healthcare, travel, and critical infrastructure. Our TrustX platform enables organisations to orchestrate secure, scalable, cross-channel identity workflows, supporting identity verification, biometric authentication, and lifecycle management across complex environments. More than two billion identities worldwide have been safeguarded by Daon technology.

Recognised as a leading provider by multiple analyst firms including Gartner®, Kuppinger Cole, and Frost & Sullivan®, Daon is at the forefront of shaping the future of identity security.

The Opportunity

Daon is looking for a world class Customer Success Consultant and Subject Matter Expert (SME) to drive customer success initiatives and support key strategic business objectives across the UK and EU markets.

As Daon’s UK and EU Market SME, you will provide expertise on digital identity, fraud prevention, and regulatory developments, supporting business development, pre-sales, product strategy, market positioning, certifications, and thought leadership. Areas of focus include UK Government digital identity initiatives, EU AMLR, ETSI 2.x, EUDI, and related market developments.

Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will work closely with customers to implement, and optimise remote Identity Verification and Customer Authentication solutions across mobile and web channels.

You will lead customer engagements from initial pre-sales stages, through implementation and ongoing success management, acting as a trusted adviser to customers and internal stakeholders. Success in this role requires strong leadership, commercial awareness, and execution capability, ensuring projects and strategic initiatives are delivered effectively, while proactively managing risk, stakeholder engagement, and customer outcomes.

Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Shape and drive Identity projects from initiation to project close. Projects include both customer facing integration projects and strategic Daon initiatives.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and track progress of their implementation of Daon technologies.
  • Liaise with internal Daon stakeholders, including business owners, product managers and engineering leads, to ensure a positive outcome for both Daon and our customers.
  • Leading efforts within Daon to attain compliance with industry standards and regulations, including leading internal initiatives in securing industry certifications.
  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships with customers, partners, and key stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor on identity and fraud prevention solutions.
  • Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate project, operational, and customer risks, ensuring issues are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate workshops, governance reviews, and stakeholder communications, including the preparation of project and executive status reporting
  • Support business development, pre-sales activities, market engagement, and strategic growth initiatives across the organisation.

Management of business processing outsource partners as required for exception process handling.

Education/Training/Experience:

Essential

  • Extensive software industry experience, typically 15+ years, including significant exposure to document-centric identity verification, authentication, or closely related fields.
  • Strong personal, communications and leadership skills and with proven ability to foster teamwork
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including managing cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Experience managing senior technical and non-technical stakeholders, both internally and externally.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional contributions to support regulatory, certification, or compliance requirements, including the creation and maintenance of supporting documentation.
  • Knowledge of UK and EU digital identity, AML, and regulatory frameworks, including DIATF, EUDI, ETSI, AMLR, and related standards.
  • Experience supporting business development, pre-sales activities, market positioning, and customer-facing engagements.
  • Track record of ability to ramp-up quickly.

Desirable

  • Experience of defining market leading Identity customer journeys
  • Experience in delivering software solutions in both SaaS/hosted and self-managed environments.
  • Strong knowledge of identity verification and authentication technologies, including document verification, biometrics, liveness detection, and fraud prevention

Qualifications

  • Relevant 3rd level qualification - honours degree
  • PMP, Prince2 or Agile certified or similar qualification advantageous

The Daon DNA and Employee Value

We believe an organization’s culture is more than just shared values and beliefs. It is created through consistent and authentic behaviours and includes honesty, integrity, respect, and professionalism.

We are seeking an individual with a proven track record of demonstrating these values and behaviours in previous roles.

We Offer

  • An opportunity to work in the growing world of biometric and identity technologies.
  • Competitive compensation and leading benefits
  • A flexible working environment to create a well-balanced work/life schedule for you and your family.

Daon DNA. Identity continuity is the idea the whole company turns on. It means a person carries one secure identity from the moment they open an account through every login, every recovery, every channel — verified in seconds, without friction, and without ever being made to feel like a suspect. Twenty-five years of biometric work sits behind that, and the problem keeps changing shape: deepfakes, injection attacks, and now autonomous software agents requesting access they haven't earned. Roughly 300 of us work on it from Ireland, the United Kingdom, Serbia, Spain, Singapore, Australia, the Philippines and the United States.

Come and join us if you want your work felt by hundreds of millions of people, every single day.

Join the brightest minds from around the globe as we build the future of digital identity!

Daon is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.
