jobs.description:
Analyste de données

Sommaire du rôle

En tant qu’analyste de données, vous appuierez la prise de décisions d’affaires en recueillant, organisant et interprétant des données afin d’identifier les tendances, les occasions et les secteurs nécessitant des améliorations. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes de l’ensemble de l’organisation pour élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord et des solutions offrant une visibilité sur les principales activités et la performance de l’entreprise.

Vous contribuerez à des projets axés sur l’amélioration des processus, l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’efficacité organisationnelle, en aidant les équipes à exploiter les données et les technologies afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’affaires et de favoriser l’amélioration continue.

Responsabilités

  • Identifier et résoudre des problèmes complexes ou ambiguës, en transformant les données en informations claires et exploitables qui influencent directement les décisions des dirigeants.
  • Concevoir des pipelines de données, des rapports, des pratiques exemplaires et des cadres de travail permettant aux analystes et aux autres parties prenantes de l’organisation d’accéder efficacement aux informations nécessaires.
  • Transformer des formats de données complexes en indicateurs de performance fondés sur les données, en tableaux de bord intelligents et en applications intégrant l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Moderniser les processus manuels en les convertissant en systèmes évolutifs, automatisés et orientés vers les insights, en tirant parti de l’analyse statistique, des plateformes de données infonuagiques (cloud) et des technologies d’intelligence artificielle.

Le.la candidat.e idéal.e en quelques mots:

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en science des données, en analytique des données, en statistique, en mathématiques, en génie, dans un domaine technique connexe ou expérience équivalente.
  • Expérience avancée dans l’utilisation de l’analytique pour résoudre des problèmes d’ingénierie, réaliser des analyses statistiques et programmer (p. ex. SQL, Python, R).
  • Expérience démontrée dans la création de tableaux de bord, de rapports et d’ensembles de données structurés pour soutenir les décisions d’affaires et d’ingénierie.
  • Excellentes compétences analytiques, en résolution de problèmes et en analyse statistique.
  • Maîtrise du français et une forte maîtrise de l’anglais est requise (la maîtrise du mandarin est un atout).

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin d’assurer des communications efficaces avec les équipes à l’extérieur du Québec et de contribuer aux activités de notre entreprise internationale.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience avec les outils d’analytique et la gestion des données propres à Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Expérience dans la conception de pipelines de données (ETL) et la modélisation des données.
  • Expérience pratique avec les modèles d’intelligence artificielle et d’apprentissage automatique (IA/AA), les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et l’automatisation des flux de travail alimentée par l’IA.
  • Solide expérience dans la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes et la présentation de solutions.

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Apprenez et évoluez à travers plusieurs projets de pointe
  • Télétravail
  • Un jour de congé supplémentaire pour votre anniversaire
  • Une rémunération globale compétitive et des avantages sociaux concurrentiels
  • Congés mobiles payés entre Noël et le Jour de l’an
  • Rabais significatif sur l'abonnement de transport en commun de Montréal
  • Faites partie d’une entreprise qui place les critères ESG au cœur de sa mission pour les personnes, la planète et la performance.

Averna souscrit au principe de l’équité en matière d’emploi et est déterminé à encourager la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous sommes heureux d’étudier la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés, sans égard à leur race, couleur, religion, orientation sexuelle, genre, nationalité d’origine, âge, handicap, statut d’ancien combattant ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

En janvier 2026, Averna et Spherea ont uni leurs forces pour former le Groupe Spherea. Leader mondial des solutions de test et de qualité, Averna Powered by Spherea collabore avec les concepteurs, développeurs et fabricants de produits afin de les aider à améliorer la qualité de leurs produits, accélérer leur mise sur le marché et protéger leurs marques, en couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits grâce à des solutions et à une expertise complète.

Averna Powered by Spherea propose une expertise spécialisée ainsi que des solutions innovantes en matière de tests, d’inspection par vision, d’assemblage de précision et d’automatisation, offrant des avantages techniques, financiers et commerciaux significatifs aux clients des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’automobile, de l’électronique grand public, de la défense, de l’énergie, de l’industrie, des dispositifs médicaux et des sciences de la vie, des semi‑conducteurs, des télécommunications et du transport.

Ses solutions comprennent le prototypage et le conseil, l’assemblage de précision et la production, des solutions de test automatisées, des systèmes de test en ligne, la réplication de systèmes de test ainsi que des plateformes et produits de test. L’expertise d’Averna Powered by Spherea couvre notamment les systèmes de vision, les tests spécialisés de batteries, les radiofréquences et micro‑ondes, la fibre optique, la robotique et le mouvement, l’instrumentation, les systèmes de contrôle et la gestion des données.

Job Description

Job Title: Sr. Sales Manager - Mining

Working Pattern: Full Time

Working location: Novi, MI or Working from Home US

Relocation assistance is available for this position.

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

Position Summary

The Sr. Sales Manager, Mining is the primary commercial driver for mtu power systems in the North American Mining market, responsible for managing sales opportunities from concept to contract across a defined territory and distribution partner network. This role owns the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new business opportunities and securing service contracts, to building C-suite customer relationships and serving as the strategic point of contact for distribution partners. With direct influence over revenue growth, market share, and long-term customer partnerships in one of Power Systems' key industrial segments, this is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for an experienced commercial leader.

What you will be doing

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities — work with distribution partners across North America to generate and advance sales opportunities for mtu power systems, securing contracts that drive profitable revenue growth in the Mining segment.
  • Build and own senior customer relationships — engage key customers at the highest management levels, negotiate and secure sales and service contracts (including VCA and EC agreements), and collaborate with the Service and Service Sales teams to deliver a total sales and service solution.
  • Manage accounts from a full commercial perspective — serve as the primary point of contact for distribution partners, address customer concerns promptly, provide guidance on policy decisions, and act as project manager when required to ensure smooth execution from concept through delivery.
  • Monitor the market and drive accurate forecasting — track industry trends, competitor activity, business conditions, and account status, reporting insights to leadership to support strategic planning and pipeline accuracy.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%).

Basic Requirements:

  • Associate's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 7+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field with 3+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of industrial equipment, OR
  • JD/PhD in Engineering, Business, or a related field, OR
  • 9+ years of experience in technical sales or service management of complex industrial power systems in lieu of a degree
  • In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent. Resident Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Preferred Requirements:

  • Strong technical knowledge and proven success in value selling complex power systems, including diesel engines, to industrial customers.
  • Strong familiarity with mining equipment, operations, and the North American Mining market.
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, SAP CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar) and MS Office Suite, with a track record of maintaining accurate pipeline data, account records, and sales forecasting in a structured commercial environment.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities from concept through contract (including project management involvement) in a distribution partner or channel sales model within the Mining, Oil & Gas, or heavy industrial sector.
  • Knowledge of mtu and/or Rolls-Royce Power Systems products, service contracts (VCA, EC), policies, and distribution network or equivalent deep familiarity with a comparable diesel engine or industrial power systems brand.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote or field-based environment, make sound commercial decisions with minimal supervision, and communicate complex technical and commercial proposals clearly to senior customer and partner stakeholders.

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics. We are committed to providing a respectful and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued and everyone can thrive.

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview: Bold AI is an AI transformation company.
jobs.description:
Company Overview: Bold AI is an AI transformation company. We help enterprises use AI to change how they work, get found inside AI answers, and create content at scale. We build the platforms that make it real.

Role Overview: As a 3D Render Artist on Bold AI's Flywheel team, you build and render 3D work with AI as a native part of your pipeline and finish in Blender. You move fast across the Creative and Production phases, taking a brief from concept to on-brand, photoreal or stylized execution at a volume that would be impossible by hand. You produce for named enterprise accounts, hold the line on brand, and feed every learning back into the system so each cycle starts sharper than the last.

About the Flywheel Platform: Flywheel is our proprietary platform that runs the content supply chain end to end. Our production team operates it, and you create inside it every day. It ingests a brand from a URL or brand book into a structured, prompt-ready profile (palette, tone, audience, visual direction), then lets you brief and generate across multiple models from one workspace, including image, motion, and text-to-3D. You organize, compare, and approve output in Collections, run an automated brand-fit and brand-safety check with Persona Lens, repair AI artifacts with Pixel Fix, and upscale to final delivery resolution. A production calendar keeps every asset and deadline on track, and one-click export ships shareable review links.

The stack you'll work in: Flywheel, Superscale, Luma, Open Art AI, Higgsfield, Canva, Claude, ChatGPT, Adobe Creative Cloud, Linear, and Topaz.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with the team in our time zone, which is EST Toronto, Canada

  • Model, texture, light, and render 3D assets for product, social, campaign, and motion

  • Use AI 3D and image tools to generate base meshes, concepts, textures, and references at high throughput inside Flywheel

  • Take generated and rendered output the last mile in Blender and Adobe: shading, lighting, compositing, and finishing to brand standard

  • Build and maintain asset libraries, material and shader presets, render templates, and prompt references that raise first-pass yield

  • Hold the line on brand across hundreds of executions for accounts like Nature Fresh Farms and Samsung

  • Keep work on-brand and platform-native, never generic AI output

  • Partner with the Creative Director and brand and production leads inside production pods

  • Feed learnings back into Flywheel so each cycle starts sharper and the system gets smarter

What You Bring

  • A strong portfolio of 3D render and motion work across product, brand, and campaign

  • Deep Blender skills: modeling, shading, lighting, and rendering (Cycles and EEVEE)

  • Daily, hands-on command of AI 3D and image tools across text-to-3D, image, video, and upscaling; you adopt new models fast (our stack includes Luma, Higgsfield, Open Art AI, Superscale, and Topaz)

  • Strong texturing and look-dev sense (Substance a plus)

  • A finishing eye that tells a good generation or raw render from a finished frame and closes the gap

  • Comfort with high throughput; you produce volume without dropping quality

  • Brand discipline to carry a client's visual identity across large execution counts

  • 4+ years of 3D and render experience in agency, studio, or in-house settings

Nice to Have

  • Motion and animation (keyframe, simulation, or procedural)

  • Real-time pipelines (Unreal Engine, Spline) or alternate DCCs (Cinema 4D, Houdini, ZBrush)

  • GPU rendering experience (Octane, Redshift, KeyShot)

  • Compositing in After Effects or Nuke

  • Experience building or maintaining 3D asset and material libraries

Role Details

  • Team: Flywheel

  • Focus: On-brand, platform-native 3D and render work at high throughput across digital initiatives

  • Collaborative, cross-functional environment with international stakeholders

This is a high-impact role for someone who is passionate about the intersection of AI and user safety, and who thrives in ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces. You'll work at the frontier of responsible AI - anticipating novel harms before they emerge, red-teaming new AI features, and translating complex policy goals into measurable product requirements.

What you'll do:

  • GenAI Safety Strategy: Own and drive the product roadmap for GenAI safety across Pinterest's AI-powered surfaces, including assisted search, content recommendations, automated moderation, and generative content creation tools
  • Threat Modeling & Red-Teaming: Lead proactive identification of risks, failure modes, and adversarial attack vectors across AI systems - designing structured red-teaming exercises and evaluation frameworks before and after product launches
  • Policy-to-Product Translation: Partner closely with Trust & Safety policy, legal, and ethics teams to translate nuanced content guidelines (e.g., self-harm, misinformation, body image) into precise, buildable product requirements and model guardrails
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering, ML, design, data science, policy, legal, comms, and operations teams to define, align, and ship AI safety solutions across global markets and diverse user populations
  • Evaluation & Measurement: Define and track quantitative safety metrics - including fairness audits, false positive/negative rates, disparate impact analysis, and content harm reduction - to ensure AI systems meet safety standards at scale
  • Incident Response: Develop and maintain AI safety incident runbooks and escalation frameworks, and lead rapid triage and remediation when AI systems produce harmful or unexpected outputs
  • Emerging Risk Anticipation: Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape to identify safety implications of new capabilities (e.g., multi-modal generation, synthetic media, agentic AI) and proactively build extensible safety infrastructure to address unknown future applications
  • Global & Cultural Sensitivity: Ensure AI safety approaches account for the needs, norms, and contexts of Pinterest's diverse global user base - avoiding one-size-fits-all solutions and centering equity in safety design
  • User & Employee Wellbeing: Champion the safety and psychological wellbeing of both users who encounter harmful content and internal teams (content reviewers, T&S specialists) who work on the front lines of content safety

What we're looking for:

  • Strong fluency in AI/ML concepts - including generative models, recommendation systems, multi-modal AI, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)

We are building the client's AWS enterprise cloud foundation from the ground up, and we are building it with an Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (Agentic-SDLC). We are not looking for an architect who reviews what agents produced. We are looking for one who builds the agents, defines the intents they execute, and treats the delivery system itself as part of the architecture they own.

This is the senior technical seat on the account. You will own the architecture across workstreams — the multi-account AWS landing zone (Network, Shared Services, and Workload Non-Prod and Prod), the application architecture running on top of it, and the platform architecture that comes next. You will also lead the operational team as tech lead: setting the technical direction, unblocking engineers, and shipping code yourself. This is a hands-on role. The person who owns the diagram is the person who writes the CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the AWS enterprise architecture end to end — multi-account governance and guardrails, Transit Gateway topology, hybrid connectivity to on-premises data centers, centralized traffic inspection, hybrid DNS, and the security posture that holds it all together. You write the ADRs, you defend them to the client, and you revisit them when they stop being true.
  • Tech Leadership with Your Hands On: Lead the operational team day to day — technical direction, design review, code review, and the architectural decisions that unblock delivery. You are also expected to build: CDK stacks, Lambda functions, agent tooling.
  • Agent Development & Orchestration: Design and extend the agents that carry our delivery — intent decomposition, design artifact generation, implementation scaffolding, validation, and gate reporting. Author the capability instructions they run on so agents produce architecture-compliant work without a human restating the standards each time. When you see the same correction made twice, you encode it once.
  • Intent-Driven Execution: Work within our Intent-Driven Framework, where intent describes client outcomes rather than task lists, ambiguity stops execution instead of getting interpreted, and every user-visible change ships behind a feature flag. High-velocity delivery in fixed-scope cycles, without scope creep or accumulated technical debt.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help systematically retire a live VB6 desktop application by moving its functionality into cloud services, while the legacy system keeps running untouched. Coexistence design — read-only replication, parity proof, staged cutover — is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.
  • Platform Direction: Lead the platform evaluation for the external digital front: understand what the client's dealers and commercial customers actually need, assess the options, and produce a recommendation leadership and the client can act on. Then design the reuse path — external identity, tenancy, API contracts that hold once a partner integrates against them.
  • Client-Facing Architecture: Be the person in the room with the client's IT and security leadership explaining why the design is what it is, and the person who translates their constraints back into design changes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Cloud Architecture Depth: Extensive years in software engineering with architecture, on production systems you were accountable for. Serverless application architecture — API Gateway, Lambda, CloudFront, Cognito with SAML federation, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and X-Ray.
  • Infrastructure as Code, Exclusively: AWS CDK in TypeScript, with opinions about stack boundaries and construct design. No console provisioning, no drift.
  • Software Engineering: Java and TypeScript at a level where you can review and write, not just discuss. Our stack is Java 25 with Spring Cloud Function on Lambda, React 19 with TypeScript, CDK in TypeScript. REST contract design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GitHub Actions with OIDC-based cloud authentication.
  • AI/ML Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic Frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, Strands, LangChain, or CrewAI). Tool and MCP integration, context engineering, and a real point of view on how agent output gets verified at a scale where you cannot read all of it. AWS Bedrock and AgentCore are a plus.
  • Hybrid and Legacy Reality: Experience shipping something that had to coexist with a system nobody was allowed to touch.

Soft Skills

  • Adaptive and Agentic Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly. You should be comfortable with a "startup within a corporate" feel where priorities shift based on impact, and where the highest-value thing this week was not on the plan two weeks ago.

jobs.description:
Proper AI is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators.

By combining automation, technology, and a global team of accounting experts, we deliver faster, more accurate financial operations at scale.

We’re a team of builders, problem-solvers, and operators from around the world, working together to modernize one of the most critical functions in real estate.

Learn more at

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong backend and systems fundamentals to help own the core of our platform: the services, data models, and automations behind workflow and productivity tooling for B2B accounting operations.

This is a depth role, not a breadth role. The work is logic-heavy — multi-service data flows, third-party platform integrations, and document-processing pipelines where correctness matters more than surface area. The engineer will be a technical counterpart to the Tech Lead on architecture, and will take ownership of our AI-backed document processing service.

The ideal candidate is language-agnostic in outlook but deep in practice: comfortable moving between Go, Python, and TypeScript, and able to build a real working model of an unfamiliar system before changing it.

Key Responsibilities

    Core Functional Responsibilities

    • Design, build, and maintain backend services across a microservices estate (Go, NestJS/TypeScript, Python).

    • Own the AI-backed document processing and classification service (Python/FastAPI): extraction quality, accuracy measurement, and the pipeline around it.

    • Design and maintain integrations with third-party platforms, including authentication, sync cadence, retries, and recovery.

    • Model data deliberately — schemas, migrations, and invariants that hold as the product changes.

    • Debug across service boundaries: correlate behaviour across multiple systems and databases to find the actual cause.

    • Build observability and provenance into automated flows: actions should be traceable, auditable, and reconstructable after the fact.

    • Design for safe automation: idempotency, pre/postconditions, dry-runs, and guardrails on anything that writes to a customer's system of record.

    • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and leave the systems better instrumented than found.

      • Performance and Metrics Tracking

      • Define and track correctness and reliability measures for owned systems (task success, error and fallback rates, accuracy of automated inference).

      • Build evaluation coverage for AI-backed output: scenario tests, invariant checks, and regression detection when a model or prompt changes.

      • Monitor and improve latency, retries, and failure recovery in automated pipelines.

        • Training and Development

        • Mentor mid-level engineers on system design, debugging methodology, and testing discipline.

        • Lead design discussions and code reviews.

        • Document architecture decisions, failure modes, and debugging runbooks.

Required Hard Skills

  • Backend engineering depth — production services in Go and/or Python; TypeScript/Node useful. Multi-language comfort matters more than any single stack.
  • Data modelling and relational databases — PostgreSQL, schema design, migrations, query performance, and reasoning about data integrity.
  • Distributed and cross-service debugging — tracing behaviour across services, queues, and databases to isolate a root cause.
  • Third-party integration engineering — external APIs with imperfect contracts: auth expiry, partial failures, retries, idempotency.
  • Reliability practice — observability, structured logging, tracing, failure-mode analysis, and recovery design.
  • Testing and evaluation — unit and scenario tests, invariant checks, and measuring correctness of non-deterministic (AI-backed) output.
  • Cloud and infrastructure — GCP preferred (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub); Docker and CI/CD.
  • Working with LLM-backed services — using them as components, understanding their failure modes, and validating their output. Prior agent-framework experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Required Soft Skills

  • Calibrates depth to stakes. Ships routine, low-risk work quickly; deliberately slows down on core systems, data models, and anything touching money or client data — and can tell the difference without being told.

  • Verifies before concluding. Checks the premise of a bug report rather than building on it; can distinguish a real defect from correct behaviour measured the wrong way. Reads the system before changing it. Builds a working model of how something actually behaves, then changes it.

  • Owns outcomes, not tickets. Goes past the literal ticket text when the ticket is wrong, incomplete, or describes the wrong problem.

  • Strong communicator of design decisions, trade-offs, and risk, to technical and non technical audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative — high standards without perfectionism, and works well with Product and Operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills / Experiences

  • Experience in both high-growth startups and larger engineering organisations. Accounting, fintech, or other domain where correctness is non-negotiable. Document processing, OCR, or information-extraction pipelines.

  • Vector databases / retrieval (e.g. Qdrant) and prompt or model evaluation. Frontend familiarity (Vue or React) — useful for full-feature ownership, not a core requirement.

  • B2B SaaS background.

Type of Degree

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. Strong CS fundamentals matter; the credential does not.

Years of Experience in Field

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, with a majority in backend or systems work. Demonstrated ownership of a non-trivial production system (not just feature delivery within someone else's design).

  • Experience at an organisation with mature engineering standards is valuable.

Das Syntax Institut ist ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

Aufgaben

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Beratung: Du informierst Interessierte umfassend über unser Kursangebot, analysierst ihre individuelle Situation und Lernziele und bereitest sie zielgerichtet auf den Kursstart vor
  • Betreuung & Onboarding: Du begleitest die Bewerber/innen als zentrale/r Ansprechpartner/in bis hin zum erfolgreichen Onboarding
  • Lead Management & CRM-Kooperation: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, insbesondere unserer CRM-Managerin unterstützt du bei Themen wie Lead Nurturing, Entwicklung von Funnels und der richtigen Ansprache, um unsere Zielgruppe bestmöglich zu erreichen und begeistern

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit anderen Menschen und kannst offen, empathisch und proaktiv - auch telefonisch - auf Bewerber/innen zugehen
  • Spaß an Dynamik und ambitionierten Zielen: Du bist motiviert klare und ambitionierte Ziele zu erreichen und dabei erstklassige Ergebnisse zu erzielen
  • Selbständigkeit und Proaktivität: Du arbeitest gerne selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und behältst stets den Überblick, insbesondere beim gleichzeitigen Bearbeiten von eingegangenen Bewerbungen
  • Technische Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit den Anwendungen der Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Kalender), Zusätzliche Hubspot Kenntnisse sind ein Plus
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst und schreibst ausgezeichnetes Deutsch und bist idealerweise auch des gesprochenen und geschriebenen Englischen mächtig (C1+)
  • Ein großes Plus: wenn du bereits Vorerfahrung im Vertrieb bzw. in der Bildungsberatung bei einem AZAV-zertifizierten Bildungsträger mitbringst

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.)
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld und flexibles Arbeiten: Für uns zählen Ergebnisse mehr als vorgeschriebene Arbeitsorte und -zeiten. Wir räumen dir die Flexibilität ein, die du brauchst, um optimal zu performen
  • Sehr attraktive Vergütung: Marktübliches Fixgehalt mit sehr attraktiver, variabler Vergütung. Außerdem profitierst du bei uns von einem vergünstigten Sportangebot bei unserem Partner Urban Sports Club und erhältst hochwertige Betriebsgeräte (MacBook, AirPods, etc.)

Unleash Your Talents with Us!

Hi there, our future .NET Developer! Happy to see YOU here.

Here at Integrated OS, you'll be part of a team of passionate individuals who are committed to delivering exceptional offshoring services. Bringing in an array of skills and talents from different areas of business from Finance, Human Resources, Information Technology, Customer Service, and Marketing to Sales and Operations.

From humble beginnings, we have built our company from our first team member onwards. Initially, we were lending support to an Australian print manufacturer - The Lamson Group.

Since then, we have continued to uphold our core values and culture and developed a deeper understanding of how people need help to succeed in their goals. And YOU might be a part of this amazing growth as our team keeps growing above all expectations!

What you'll do:

As a .NET Developer – Legacy Applications, you will be responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance and enhancement of an established ASP.NET MVC application and its underlying SQL Server database. The application has been in production for a number of years, underpins live business operations, and is relied upon daily — so stability, careful change control and a deep working knowledge of the existing code matter more here than greenfield development.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who is comfortable working inside a mature codebase: reading unfamiliar code, tracing issues through layers that pre-date current standards, and making measured improvements without disrupting what already works. You will need to be a problem solver, self-motivated and proactive, and able to operate with limited documentation while progressively improving it.

Key responsibilities for this role includes:

  • Maintain, support and enhance the existing ASP.NET MVC application, ensuring the stability, security and performance of a long-standing production system.
  • Take ownership across the full support and development lifecycle, including:
    • Diagnose and resolve defects, production incidents and performance bottlenecks across both the application and the SQL Server database.
    • Develop new features and enhancements within the existing MVC architecture, writing clean, well-documented C# that is consistent with established patterns in the codebase.
    • Write, review and optimise T-SQL — stored procedures, views, functions and indexes — and tune long-running or resource-intensive queries.
    • Test and deploy changes with care, recognising that regression risk is elevated in a mature codebase with limited automated test coverage.
  • Reverse-engineer and document undocumented areas of the application and database schema, progressively reducing key-person risk.
  • Apply framework, library and security patching, and remediate vulnerabilities in ageing dependencies.
  • Contribute to the modernisation roadmap by identifying candidates for refactoring, incremental uplift or migration to a supported .NET version.
  • Work with business stakeholders to translate change requests into practical, low-risk technical solutions, and ensure all changes comply with IVE's security, data handling and change management requirements.

Successful candidates must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on .NET development experience, including significant recent experience with ASP.NET MVC (MVC 4/5) on the .NET Framework.
  • Strong C# and object-oriented programming skills, with a solid grasp of the MVC pattern — controllers, Razor views, routing, model binding and dependency injection.
  • Strong SQL Server skills, including complex T-SQL, stored procedures, views, indexing and query performance tuning against large, established schemas.
  • Experience with data access technologies common to older applications (Entity Framework 6, ADO.NET, LINQ to SQL or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining, debugging and enhancing legacy or inherited codebases with limited documentation and low automated test coverage.
  • Solid experience with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap.
  • Working knowledge of IIS, application pools, web.config configuration and Windows Server hosting.
  • Proficient in version control systems (Git, TFS/TFVC, SVN) and familiar with build and deployment tooling (Azure DevOps, TFS).
  • Experience developing and consuming APIs (ASP.NET Web API, WCF or REST services).
  • Excellent problem-solving and diagnostic skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in live production environments.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members and to explain legacy system constraints in plain language.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • A pragmatic mindset — comfortable making careful, incremental improvements to a mature system rather than rebuilding it.

Work Arrangements:

  • Schedule: 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM PHT
  • Work Setup: Work From Home Setup
  • Office Location: Parkway Corporate Center, Alabang, Muntinlupa City

What's in it for YOU?
At Integrated OS, we create career opportunities where you can thrive, grow, and make an impact.

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: Be rewarded for your expertise and dedication.
  • Career Growth & Development: Work alongside international clients and gain valuable experience.
  • Work-Life Balance: Our innovative activities, open communication channels, and commitment to inclusivity make every day exciting and rewarding!
  • Collaborative & Supportive Environment: Be part of a passionate team that values innovation and teamwork.

Your seat awaits! Be part of our thriving team and CLICK APPLY!

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.

o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views

o Query optimisation

• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.

• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.

• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

jobs.excerpt: Senior C++ Software EngineerRemote (UK-based) | Full-TimeAbout UsReactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ().
jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
Azure IoT Solutions Architect

This is a fully remote position with potential occasional travel within the United States required.

PURPOSE

The Azure IoT Solutions Architect is a senior, hands-on technical leader responsible for designing, securing, and guiding delivery of enterprise and product-focused Internet of Things (IoT) solutions for manufacturing clients. The role leads end-to-end architecture across connected devices, edge gateways, industrial connectivity, Azure cloud services, data integration, and operational monitoring while ensuring security-by-design is embedded throughout the product lifecycle.

This role provides the technical leadership needed to support development teams building or modernizing products with digital elements. The successful candidate will translate the compliance related product-security requirements into actionable architecture decisions, engineering controls, evidence, roadmaps, epics, and user stories in partnership with legal, compliance, product, engineering, and operations stakeholders.

The position blends Azure IoT solution architecture, product cybersecurity, industrial and manufacturing integration, cloud security engineering, regulatory readiness, and Agile delivery leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

IoT Solution Architecture & Manufacturing Integration

  • Design and lead secure end-to-end IoT architectures spanning connected products, embedded or edge systems, gateways, networks, Azure services, APIs, applications, data platforms, and operational support capabilities.

  • Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for device onboarding, telemetry ingestion, command and control, digital services, remote diagnostics, and lifecycle management.

  • Architect Azure IoT solutions using services such as Azure IoT Hub, Device Provisioning Service, IoT Edge, Event Hubs, Functions, Stream Analytics, storage, monitoring, and integration services as appropriate to the solution.

  • Guide integration with manufacturing and operational technology environments, including industrial gateways, plant networks, and protocols such as MQTT, AMQP, HTTPS, and OPC UA.

  • Evaluate scalability, resilience, latency, availability, data retention, regional deployment, disaster recovery, and cost requirements for global IoT solutions.

Product Cybersecurity Architecture & Engineering

  • Embed security-by-design, security-by-default, Zero Trust, and least-privilege principles across device, edge, network, cloud, application, and operational architectures.

  • Define device identity and trust models, including X.509 certificates, public key infrastructure, secure provisioning, key rotation, hardware-backed trust, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle processes.

  • Establish architecture requirements for secure boot, signed firmware and software, encrypted communications, secure update and rollback, tamper resistance, logging, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Lead threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, architecture risk assessments, and security design reviews for connected products and supporting remote data processing services.

  • Define and review Azure-native controls using Entra ID, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Defender for IoT, Microsoft Sentinel, network security controls, and centralized monitoring.

Compliance Leadership

  • Serve as the technical lead for compliance readiness for products with digital elements, working with legal and compliance stakeholders to determine scope, product classification, support obligations, and the appropriate conformity assessment pathway.

  • Translate applicable compliance essential cybersecurity and vulnerability-handling requirements into technical controls, development standards, acceptance criteria, test evidence, and operational processes.

  • Establish or mature product cybersecurity risk assessments, technical documentation, secure configuration guidance, user instructions, support-period planning, and compliance evidence needed for product release and ongoing market support.

  • Define software bill of materials (SBOM), third-party component governance, vulnerability intake, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, remediation, security advisory, and secure update processes.

  • Design reporting and escalation workflows for actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe security incidents, including coordination with product security incident response, legal, compliance, operations, and executive stakeholders.

  • Support audit and conformity-assessment readiness through control mapping, evidence review, architecture traceability, gap assessments, and remediation planning.

Cloud Platform, DevSecOps & Lifecycle Delivery

  • Architect secure Azure landing zones, subscriptions, network segmentation, private connectivity, identity, logging, and governance patterns for IoT development, test, production, and support environments.

  • Define Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code patterns using Bicep, ARM, Terraform, or equivalent automation frameworks.

  • Design CI/CD and DevSecOps controls for cloud infrastructure, applications, edge modules, firmware interfaces, configuration, automated testing, security scanning, and release approvals.

  • Develop and maintain IoT, product-security, and CRA-readiness roadmaps; prioritize architecture, security, and compliance work based on business value, product risk, regulatory deadlines, and delivery dependencies.

  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, architecture governance, and release-readiness activities; ensure delivery teams execute against approved architectural and security standards.

Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to software, firmware, infrastructure, cybersecurity, manufacturing, operations, product, legal, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Present complex IoT architecture, cybersecurity, and regulatory topics in clear, business-focused language and communicate risks, decisions, dependencies, and remediation strategies.

  • Mentor architects, engineers, and developers on Azure IoT, product cybersecurity, secure engineering practices, and regulatory readiness.

  • Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical assessments, and cross-functional problem resolution for IoT initiatives.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned by management.

REQUIRED, SKILLS, EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, software architecture, cybersecurity, or related technical leadership roles.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering IoT, connected-product, edge, or industrial technology solutions, preferably in manufacturing environments.

  • Demonstrated experience designing Azure IoT solutions using Azure IoT Hub, Device Provisioning Service, IoT Edge, event and messaging services, data integration, and Azure monitoring and security capabilities.

  • Strong knowledge of IoT and industrial communication patterns and protocols, including MQTT, AMQP, HTTPS, OPC UA, device gateways, intermittent connectivity, and store-and-forward designs.

  • Strong knowledge of device identity, X.509 certificates, PKI, secure provisioning, cryptography, key management, secure update mechanisms, and product vulnerability management.

  • Demonstrated familiarity with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, including manufacturer obligations, essential cybersecurity requirements, vulnerability handling, support periods, technical documentation, reporting, and conformity-assessment readiness.

  • Experience applying secure development lifecycle, threat modeling, risk assessment, SBOM, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and product security incident response practices.

  • Strong knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, governance, observability, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Proven experience working in Agile delivery environments and translating architecture, security, and regulatory requirements into actionable backlog items and acceptance criteria.

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.

PREFERRED SKILLS, EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate or comparable Azure security certification.

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC.

  • ISA/IEC 62443 training or certification and experience applying IEC 62443 in industrial or manufacturing environments.

  • Experience with ETSI EN 303 645, NISTIR 8259, ISO 27001, TISAX, or other product, IoT, or industrial cybersecurity frameworks.

  • Experience supporting CRA, CE-marking, conformity-assessment, audit, or regulated product-release activities.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, real-time operating systems, firmware development interfaces, hardware security modules, trusted platform modules, or secure elements.

  • Experience with SBOM formats and tooling such as SPDX or CycloneDX and with software composition analysis and vulnerability management platforms.

Starting Compensation Range: $155,000 per year

The salary for this position is commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.

  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.

  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.

  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.

You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
We are seeking an experienced AWS Principal Software Engineer to join our AWS practice Managed Service's team. This is a fully remote opportunity based in the Philippines.
TTEC is a global company that is 46,000+ employees strong. Together, we are transforming the world of customer experience by helping our clients design and deliver simpler, more effective, efficient, and human customer service experiences that inspire customer loyalty and boost company profits.
As a technical member of the Managed Services team, you will maintain the AWS Practice’s designed solution for our clients. Maintaining the production systems will involve identifying and addressing issues the client is experiencing, building, testing, and deploying those changes to the client's system. AWS Engineers will work to refine the process of delivering projects by building internal tools, suggesting new methods for designing and building systems, and providing feedback to clients on issues they are experiencing.
This is a permanent, fully remote position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be willing to work US business hours to support our global clients and operations.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Daily meetings with the internal team

  • Weekly meetings with clients and TTEC Digital client account managers

  • Requirements analysis and design conversations when you have a new enhancement to build.

  • Working on issues in Jira with your team - building systems, creating CloudFormation/Serverless templates to deploy resources, etc.

  • Learning best practices used in the NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python communities

  • Working with your mentor/team lead to further knowledge of AWS Services, tools, or even new languages to address client issues

  • Learning new ways of doing things and sharing new learnings with internal team members

  • You need to be ready to learn quickly!

What You Bring to the Role

  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture

  • 5+ years’ development experience with 3+ years of development experience with a focus on TypeScript/, working with AWS services

  • Functional knowledge of agile methodologies such as Scrum

  • The ideal candidate seeks to understand before prescribing a solution.

  • A love for technology and the latest and greatest in development best practices, especially the latest services from AWS

About Us

TTEC Digital and our 1,800+ employees, pioneer engagement and growth solutions that fuel the exceptional customer experience (CX). Our sister company, TTEC Engage, is a 60,000+ employee service company, with customer service representatives located around the world. TTEC Holdings Inc. is the parent company for both Digital and Engage. When clients have a holistic need, they can draw from these independently managed centers of excellence, TTEC Digital and TTEC Engage.
We are also delighted to share that TTEC has been awarded the Great Place To Work 2024-2025 certification based on outstanding employee experience across 14 countries.
TTEC is a proud equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability. TTEC has fully embraced and is committed to expanding our diverse and inclusive workforce. We strive to reflect the communities we serve while delivering amazing service and technology centered around humanity.
Rarely do applicants meet all desired job qualifications, so if you feel you would succeed in the role above, please take a moment and share your qualifications.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hello!  We're Teya. Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe.
jobs.description:
Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

jobs.excerpt: Engagement OverviewInflect is engaging an independent Sr.
jobs.description:
Engagement Overview

Inflect is engaging an independent Sr. DevOps & Infrastructure Consultant (Prestador de Servicios Independiente) in Mexico through Rippling (acting as a Contractor of Record) to architect, deliver, and maintain critical cloud platform components. This is an autonomous, high-impact B2B consulting engagement focused on production reliability, platform substrate engineering, and observability pipelines.

Working as an external subject matter expert, your company will provide high-level technical guidance and infrastructure delivery for Inflect's AWS EKS environment, ensuring our platform runs with high availability, efficiency, and automated resilience.

Who We Are

We are a US-based advisory and marketplace that is revolutionizing the way companies buy and sell digital infrastructure (Datacenter, cloud, and network services). Digital infrastructure services are the building blocks of the internet and at the core of every industry. Traditionally it’s been bought manually through service provider sales people, resulting in high costs, slow procurement cycles, and services that aren’t the best fit - slowing down the ability of companies to build and innovate. Inflect’s marketplace and advisory are removing friction so any company can get what they need, when they need it, with the right deal terms. By achieving our mission, we unlock businesses to build and human innovation to inflect!

Specialized Technical Capabilities Required

  • Infrastructure & Platform Substrate: Deep expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) operating on AWS EKS, RDS, ingress controllers, TLS certificate automation, in addition to implementing cloud cost/capacity tuning.
  • Production Reliability & SRE Rigor: Proven track record defining SLOs/SLIs, establishing error budget frameworks, and building automation to drive down system toil.
  • Telemetry Architecture: Hands-on experience designing and operating OpenTelemetry collection and routing pipelines.
  • Async Communication & Advisory: Fluent professional English communication skills for effective cross-border async collaboration and code review advisory.

Scope of Services & Deliverables

  • Platform Substrate & Infrastructure: Deliver and maintain Terraform modules on AWS EKS, managed RDS instances, ingress controllers, and cost optimization architectures.
  • SRE & Reliability Standards: Establish SLO/SLI tracking frameworks, automate error budget monitoring, participate in post-incident technical reviews, and build automated tooling to reduce operational friction.
  • Telemetry Pipeline Architecture: Architect and maintain the OpenTelemetry capture pipeline feeding telemetry data to downstream Data Foundation and Trust & Intelligence pods.
  • Technical Advisory & Review: Provide specialized code reviews, pull-request assessments, and technical architecture recommendations to maintain high platform standards.
  • Paved Road Enablement: Develop reusable platform patterns and automated CI/CD tooling to streamline developer deployment workflows. Define Operating model and reflect via Global Runbook inclusive of SOP’s, regional coordination, and issue remediation/management.

Engagement Terms & Compliance Structure

  • Location:Mexico
  • Contract Type: Fixed-rate monthly Independent B2B Service Agreement executed via Rippling, $6,000-$8,000 USD/mo based on experience
  • Invoicing & Tax Compliance: Contractor must be registered with the SAT (e.g., RESICO or Persona Física con Actividad Empresarial) and issue valid CFDI invoices uploaded through Rippling.
  • Autonomy: Complete flexibility over work schedules, location, and execution methods necessary to fulfill project SLAs and agreed milestones.
  • Commercial Relationship: Strictly B2B consulting engagement; no employment relationship under the Federal Labor Law (LFT), Aguinaldo (Christmas bonus), profit sharing (PTU), or employee benefit guarantees are implied.

Your work will have a strong impact on user experience, customer satisfaction, and company growth. We work in an agile environment utilizing modern tools such as AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, and Kafka.
